detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps animating directional transit icons (vehicles, drones, arrows) along curved pathways must utilize offset-rotate: auto to ensure smooth angular rotation without jitter.

title: CSS offset-anchor Property: Kinetic Transform Pivot & Visual Element Registration
description: Standardizes the offset-anchor property, specifying the point inside the element's box that is positioned at the location along the path determined by offset-path and offset-distance.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Motion Path Module Level 1 - Section 3 Defining the Anchor Point
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts auto or <position> (e.g. center, 50% 50%, top left). When auto is specified, the anchor point defaults to the value of the transform-origin property.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Crucial for accurately positioning irregularly shaped pin markers, speech bubbles, and vehicle icons so that their physical contact point (e.g. bottom tip of a map pin or center of a vehicle) locks precisely to the route vector.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Computed statically during element styling, avoiding geometry drift or re-anchoring reflows during continuous trajectory animation.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps rendering custom map pins or vehicle sprites along motion paths must define explicit offset-anchor coordinates matching the visual focal point of the graphic asset.

title: W3C CSS Box Alignment Module Level 3: Unified Flow-Relative Alignment Model
description: Standardizes the W3C CSS Box Alignment Module Level 3 specification, providing a unified declarative model for distributing space and aligning boxes across all CSS layout modes including Flexbox, Grid, and Block layouts.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Box Alignment Module Level 3 - Section 1 Overview & Unified Alignment Model
detail.technical_mechanics: Defines positional alignment (start, end, center), baseline alignment (first baseline, last baseline), and distributed alignment (space-between, space-around, space-evenly, stretch) across both inline and block axes without requiring layout-specific hacks or manual margins.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables multi-tenant super app containers to enforce consistent micro-widget spacing, card header/footer distribution, and checkout summary alignment across diverse screen densities and device form factors.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Computed natively within the browser layout engine's formatting context, eliminating JavaScript layout recalculation loops and preventing Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) during dynamic widget rendering.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini app developer packages must utilize native CSS Box Alignment properties rather than JavaScript-driven DOM bounding box calculations for UI alignment to comply with super app frame-budget standards.

title: CSS place-content Shorthand: Two-Axis Container Distribution Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the CSS place-content shorthand property, enabling simultaneous declarative configuration of align-content (block axis) and justify-content (inline axis) in flex, grid, and block formatting contexts.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Box Alignment Module Level 3 - Section 5 Content-Distribution Shorthand
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts one or two values representing <'align-content'> and <'justify-content'>. If one value is provided, it sets both axes identically when valid, distributing available container space across rows and columns.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows mini app modal sheets, action dialogs, and empty-state placeholders to achieve deterministic bidirectional centering or edge-distribution with a single declarative rule, preventing widget content overflows.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Executed directly during the layout reflow phase by the browser engine; avoids DOM mutation churn and reduces CSS payload size across distributed mini app bundles.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps rendering full-screen dialogs or empty-state cards must use place-content: center or standard distribution values to ensure responsive containment across foldables and tablets.

title: CSS justify-items Property: Inline-Axis Item Alignment & Subtree Default Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the CSS justify-items property, defining default inline-axis alignment for all items inside a grid container or block formatting context.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Box Alignment Module Level 3 - Section 6 Self-Alignment: The justify-items Property
detail.technical_mechanics: Controls item alignment along the inline (horizontal in horizontal-tb) axis with values including normal, stretch, start, end, center, baseline, and legacy. Establishes the default justify-self value for all descendant grid items.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables super app catalog feeds to establish strict layout containment boundaries for merchant product cards, ensuring third-party titles, badges, and pricing elements align consistently along the inline axis.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Prevents individual child components from inheriting unpredictable inline alignment from host application CSS, preserving modular visual isolation.
detail.store_review_rule: Merchant product grid layouts in mini apps must define explicit justify-items properties on container grids to ensure predictable visual hierarchy across varied device viewports.

title: CSS align-content Property: Block-Axis Track Distribution & Multi-Line Flow Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the CSS align-content property, controlling how space is distributed between and around content tracks along the block axis in grid, flex, and block containers.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Box Alignment Module Level 3 - Section 5 Content Distribution: The align-content Property
detail.technical_mechanics: Distributes extra space along the block (cross) axis using values such as start, end, center, space-between, space-around, space-evenly, and stretch. Supports block containers in modern rendering engines.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Crucial for mini app checkout drawers, sticky action bars, and multi-line service category chips, guaranteeing that content tracks do not crowd the status bar or get clipped by bottom navigation bars.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Eliminates hardcoded pixel margins and flex-grow stretching hacks, allowing container height variations to resolve gracefully without triggering multi-pass layout thrashing.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps displaying multi-item lists or checkout breakdowns must utilize align-content with proper fallback distributions to avoid visual truncation on small-screen mobile devices.

title: CSS row-gap Property: Block-Axis Gutter Sandboxing Between Embedded Widgets
description: Standardizes the CSS row-gap property, establishing specified gutters between rows in grid, flex, and multi-column layouts without boundary margin collapse.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Box Alignment Module Level 3 - Section 8 Gaps Between Boxes: The row-gap Property
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts length or percentage values. Establishes spacing between item rows without applying at outer container bounds, preventing parent boundary overflow and margin bleeding.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Provides guaranteed vertical spatial isolation between independent mini app widgets in super app feed streams, preventing adjacent cards from touching or bleeding box shadows.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Computed natively during track sizing, avoiding expensive pseudo-selector margin overrides (such as :last-child margin-bottom: 0) that cause CSS selector matching overhead.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini app feed lists and vertical card collections must use standard row-gap properties instead of element bottom margins to guarantee composable spacing in host embed scenarios.

title: W3C CSS Text Decoration Module Level 3: Typographic Lines & Visual Text Accents
description: Standardizes the W3C CSS Text Decoration Module Level 3 specification, establishing normative rules for text decoration lines (underlines, overlines, line-throughs) and visual emphasis marks across multilingual typography.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Text Decoration Module Level 3 - Section 1 Overview & Line Decorations
detail.technical_mechanics: Defines declarative properties for text-decoration-line, text-decoration-color, text-decoration-style, and text-decoration-thickness, establishing how decorative lines interact with text runs, font metrics, and inline box fragments.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables super app container webviews to render consistent accessible link affordances, strike-through pricing for merchant promotions, and security warning underlines across multi-brand mini apps.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Handled natively by GPU text rasterizers and layout engines without generating synthetic DOM highlight nodes or border-bottom layout shifts.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini app merchant storefronts displaying discount pricing must use standard text-decoration: line-through with accessible contrast rather than non-standard SVG overlays or background images.

title: CSS text-decoration-line & style: Declarative Link & Error Indication Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the CSS text-decoration-line and text-decoration-style properties, defining the decoration geometry (underline, line-through) and stroke pattern (solid, double, dotted, dashed, wavy).

detail.specification: W3C CSS Text Decoration Module Level 3 - Section 2 Line Decoration Properties
detail.technical_mechanics: Supports multiple line positions simultaneously (e.g. underline overline) and diverse stroke styles including wavy for spellcheck/validation errors and dashed for supplementary tooltips.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows mini app checkout and KYC validation forms to convey input warnings and grammar suggestions natively (using wavy red/amber lines) that conform to native OS accessibility conventions.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Requires zero canvas drawing overhead or DOM reflows when toggling validation warning indicators on dynamic form fields.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini app input validation error markers on text fields must utilize text-decoration-style: wavy or aria-invalid attributes to ensure compliance with WCAG 2.2 color-independent feedback requirements.

title: CSS text-underline-offset: Baseline Clearance & Typographic Legibility Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the CSS text-underline-offset property, specifying the offset distance of an underline from its original typographic baseline position.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Text Decoration Module Level 4 - Section 3 Line Decoration Offsets
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts auto, length units (e.g. 0.2em, 3px), or percentage values. Moves the underline downward away from the font baseline without altering line-height or causing box-model reflow.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Crucial for Southeast Asian and CJK typography (e.g. Vietnamese diacritics below base glyphs like nặng dot, Lao bottom vowels/subscripts), ensuring underlines do not collide with or obscure phonetic tone marks.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Prevents font metric clipping and avoids the need for heavy custom padding-bottom / border-bottom CSS hacks that cause layout thrashing on low-end mobile hardware.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps localizing for Vietnamese, Lao, Thai, or Arabic locales must specify adequate text-underline-offset on links and tabs to prevent obscuring sub-baseline diacritics and vowel marks.

title: CSS text-decoration-skip-ink: Glyphic Descender Clipping Prevention & Readability
description: Standardizes the CSS text-decoration-skip-ink property, specifying how overlines and underlines are drawn when they cross glyph descenders and ascenders.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Text Decoration Module Level 4 - Section 3.2 Text Decoration Line Continuity: text-decoration-skip-ink
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts auto, all, and none. In auto mode, the browser engine automatically breaks underline strokes around descenders (such as 'p', 'g', 'y', 'j', and complex multilingual glyphs) to maximize character legibility.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Guarantees that third-party merchant mini app links maintain clean visual legibility across multilingual product listings without manual SVG clipping or font modifications.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Executed during glyph vector rasterization in the GPU compositor thread; eliminates character obscuration without CPU runtime penalties.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini app webviews must retain text-decoration-skip-ink: auto as default on interactive hyperlinks to maintain readability standards across localized scripts.

title: CSS text-emphasis Shorthand: Asian Script Accent Marks & Localized Emphasis Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the CSS text-emphasis shorthand property (combining text-emphasis-style and text-emphasis-color), applying typographic emphasis marks (such as dots, circles, sesame marks) to characters.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Text Decoration Module Level 3 - Section 3 Emphasis Marks
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts style shapes (dot, circle, double-circle, triangle, sesame, or custom string) and color. Positions marks above horizontal text (or right of vertical text) based on text-emphasis-position without altering font weights.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Provides native support for East Asian typographic conventions (Japanese kenten, Chinese boushi) in mini apps, enabling cultural text emphasis without distorting bold weights or violating brand guidelines.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Renders emphasis symbols via the browser's native text run compositor, eliminating reliance on auxiliary span elements and pseudo-elements that inflate DOM size.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps targeting East Asian regional markets must employ standard CSS text-emphasis properties for callouts and prominent terms rather than injecting redundant markup or inline images.

title: PaymentRequest.show() Method: Native Sheet Presentation & User Intent Verification
description: Standardizes the PaymentRequest.show() method, prompting the user agent to present the native payment user interface and await user authorization or dismissal.

detail.specification: W3C Payment Request API - Section 4.3 The show() method
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts an optional detailsPromise parameter. Returns a Promise that resolves to a PaymentResponse object if the user authorizes payment, or rejects with an AbortError / SecurityError if dismissed or called without user activation.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Acts as the explicit security boundary where guest mini apps relinquish UI control to the host super app's native payment modal, preventing clickjacking or deceptive UI spoofing during fund transfers.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Requires transient user activation (user gesture); invoking show() in background frames or unprompted script runs is rejected immediately by the host runtime.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps must only trigger PaymentRequest.show() in direct response to user touch/click events (e.g. tapping 'Pay Now'); background or programmatic auto-invocations fail security automated review.

title: PaymentRequest Interface & Constructor: Method Descriptors & Details Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the PaymentRequest constructor and interface, defining payment method identifiers, line items, transaction totals, and optional modifier structures.

detail.specification: W3C Payment Request API - Section 4 The PaymentRequest Interface
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts paymentMethods (sequence of PaymentMethodData objects with supportedMethods URI/string and method-specific data), details (PaymentDetailsInit containing total, displayItems, and shippingOptions), and optional options (PaymentOptions for billing/shipping requirements).
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Provides super app hosts with a strictly typed data contract to validate order total amounts, currency codes (ISO 4217), and supported proprietary super app payment schemes (e.g. https://superapp.org/pay) before displaying confirmation UI.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Instantiated objects maintain structured immutable clones of transaction metadata, preventing guest JavaScript from altering order totals after the payment sheet is presented.
detail.store_review_rule: PaymentRequest parameters submitted by mini apps must strictly adhere to ISO 4217 currency standards and accurate line-item breakdowns; discrepancy between line items and total results in immediate transaction rejection.

title: PaymentRequest.canMakePayment(): Silent Capability Detection & Anti-Fingerprinting Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the PaymentRequest.canMakePayment() asynchronous method, determining whether the user agent or payment handler supports at least one requested payment method.

detail.specification: W3C Payment Request API - Section 4.2 canMakePayment Algorithm & Privacy Considerations
detail.technical_mechanics: Returns a Promise resolving to a boolean. To mitigate user fingerprinting and tracking across origins, the specification restricts information disclosure by returning false or rate-limiting responses if queried excessively across unactivated contexts.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows mini apps to intelligently show or hide 'Pay with SuperApp Wallet' CTA buttons without leaking whether the user possesses specific external credit cards or banking apps.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Asynchronous query resolves without launching background daemon processes or waking dormant payment apps unless legitimate user gesture activation is present.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps must invoke canMakePayment() only to adapt checkout button availability; automated batch probing of multiple payment methods across unprompted page loads is flagged as fingerprinting during automated review.

title: PaymentResponse Interface: Tokenized Payment Resolution & Lifecycle Completion
description: Standardizes the PaymentResponse interface returned when a user authorizes a payment request, providing transaction tokens and the complete() resolution method.

detail.specification: W3C Payment Request API - Section 5 The PaymentResponse Interface
detail.technical_mechanics: Exposes requestId, methodName, details (opaque payment token / JSON payload), shippingAddress, payerName, payerEmail, and complete(result). Calling complete('success' | 'fail') closes the host payment sheet and notifies the user interface.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Standardizes the secure handoff of digitally signed payment tokens from the super app host wallet back to the merchant mini app's frontend for backend settlement confirmation.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Imposes a timeout limit on the pending PaymentResponse; failure of the mini app to invoke complete() within the timeout automatically aborts the transaction and closes the sheet to release resources.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini app checkout handlers must invoke paymentResponse.complete('success'|'fail') within 30 seconds of token reception; unresolved payment promises trigger automated runtime container warnings.

title: PaymentAddress Interface: Redacted Shipping Fulfillment & PII Privacy Boundary
description: Standardizes the PaymentAddress interface representing physical billing and shipping address information collected during a payment transaction.

detail.specification: W3C Payment Request API - Section 6 The PaymentAddress Interface
detail.technical_mechanics: Encapsulates country, addressLine, region, city, dependentLocality, postalCode, sortingCode, organization, recipient, and phone. Supports redaction during shippingaddresschange events to protect buyer PII until final order confirmation.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables e-commerce mini apps to calculate accurate shipping fees and delivery estimates without harvesting full buyer street addresses prematurely, enforcing privacy-by-design principles.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Data structures are sanitized and validated against ISO 3166 country codes before transmission, preventing malformed Unicode or injection payloads from entering merchant databases.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps requesting delivery addresses must request only necessary address fields through PaymentOptions and must not store full physical addresses prior to explicit user payment authorization.

title: W3C CSS will-change Module Level 1: Compositor Hinting & Stacking Context Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the will-change property, providing user agents with explicit advance notice of properties expected to animate, enabling hardware acceleration layer creation without excessive memory footprint.

detail.specification: W3C CSS will-change Module Level 1 - W3C Working Draft / CSSWG
detail.technical_mechanics: Informs the browser rendering engine ahead of time that an element will undergo property mutations. Declaring will-change triggers layer promotion to the GPU compositor thread and establishes a new stacking context and containing block when set to transform, opacity, or filter.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Prevents frame drops during mini app drawer transitions, modal bottom-sheets, and carousel interactions by promoting critical UI nodes to dedicated GPU surfaces prior to gesture execution.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Prevents aggressive GPU VRAM exhaustion on budget mobile devices by mandating runtime removal of will-change hints once animations complete, avoiding persistent compositing backing store allocation.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps must not apply will-change globally across universal selectors (*) or permanently on static DOM nodes. Container linters must flag persistent will-change declarations exceeding 10 elements simultaneously.

title: CSS will-change Property Mechanics: Compositing Layer Isolation & Containing Block Anchoring
description: Specifies property syntax, initial auto values, and side-effects including stacking context and containing block generation for fixed/absolute descendants.

detail.specification: W3C CSS will-change Module Level 1 / MDN Web Docs Reference
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts keywords auto, scroll-position, contents, or specific <custom-ident> property names (e.g., transform, opacity). Setting will-change: transform forces the element to act as a containing block for position: fixed descendants.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Ensures that sticky banners, interactive action sheets, and custom camera overlays inside mini apps correctly contain fixed-position child elements within their own layout boundaries.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Container runtime intercepts memory warnings; when memory pressure reaches critical thresholds, WebView engines can discard non-visible compositor backing stores initialized via will-change.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps utilizing will-change on container elements wrapping third-party SDK widgets must ensure position: fixed child modals do not escape clipping boundaries.

title: CSS will-change Resource Management: Layer De-escalation & Memory Pressure Lifecycle
description: Defines browser heuristics for allocating and freeing graphical resources in response to will-change declarations during dynamic DOM lifecycles.

detail.specification: CSSWG Editor's Draft - CSS will-change Module Level 1 / MDN Layout Guide
detail.technical_mechanics: Clarifies that user agents treat will-change as a non-binding hint. Browsers may throttle or deny layer promotion if system memory budgets are exhausted or if too many layers compete for GPU rasterization.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables multi-instance mini app tabs on low-end Android devices to degrade gracefully to main-thread software rasterization without crashing the host container when VRAM limits are reached.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Mandates that mini app frameworks hook into transitionend / animationend events to reset will-change back to 'auto', immediately reclaiming GPU backing buffers.
detail.store_review_rule: Automated code analysis verifies that JavaScript animation libraries bundled in mini apps programmatically clean up inline will-change styles after completing interactive transitions.

title: Compositor-Driven Animated Properties: Off-Main-Thread UI Acceleration Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the isolation of GPU-accelerated animatable properties (transform, opacity) that can bypass layout and paint recalculations during 60/120fps rendering.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Transitions & Animations / MDN Hardware-Accelerated Animation Guide
detail.technical_mechanics: Distinguishes between properties requiring reflow (width, height, top, left), repaint (color, background-color), and composite-only properties (transform, opacity, filter). Layer promotion allows compositor thread manipulation.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables super app mini apps to maintain smooth 60fps frame rates for complex financial dashboards, crypto price tickers, and ride-hailing map overlays even during intensive background JSON serialization.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Directing animations exclusively to composite-only properties reduces CPU utilization and prevents thermal throttling and battery drain across enterprise mobile devices.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini app UI audits require continuous animations to use transform and opacity; animations modifying margin, top, left, width, or height are flagged for performance remediation.

title: CSS transform Property: 2D/3D Hardware Transformation & Render Surface Sandboxing
description: Standardizes visual coordinate space modification via translate(), scale(), rotate(), and skew(), establishing independent render passes isolated from sibling geometry.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Transforms Module Level 1 / Level 2 Specification
detail.technical_mechanics: Applies affine transformation matrices to the element box. When paired with 3D functions or will-change: transform, the browser instantiates a distinct composited layer (RenderLayerBacking) handled by the GPU rasterizer.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Permits mini app popup drawers, floating navigation buttons, and bottom tab sheets to move across the screen without triggering parent super app layout recalculations.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Isolates transform invalidation strictly to the transformed layer's texture buffer, avoiding full-screen frame buffer re-rasterization during micro-interactions.
detail.store_review_rule: Modal transitions and drawer menus in mini app packages must utilize CSS transform: translate3d() or translate() rather than absolute coordinate shifts to ensure 60fps compliance.

title: W3C CSS Shapes Module Level 1: Non-Rectangular Float Geometry & Inline Flow Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the definition of non-rectangular geometric shapes for wrapping inline content around floats, establishing declarative geometric exclusion sandboxes within mini app containers.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Shapes Module Level 1 - CSSWG Editor's Draft
detail.technical_mechanics: Defines CSS properties shape-outside, shape-margin, and shape-image-threshold. Allows floated elements to project arbitrary polygonal, circular, or alpha-mask geometric contours into the surrounding inline formatting context.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables rich editorial product layouts, circular vendor avatars, and organic promotional banners inside super app mini app storefronts without requiring fragile absolute-positioned text hacks.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Shapes calculations run strictly during the float layout pass; complex polygons with high vertex counts are clamped by container style sanitizers to prevent layout thread blocking.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps must ensure shape-outside declarations with SVG or image sources are served from authorized CDN origins and do not trigger cross-origin canvas tainting or excessive polygon complexity.

title: CSS shape-outside Property: Arbitrary Geometric Boundaries & Content Wrapping Sandboxing
description: Specifies the shape-outside property syntax, accepting <basic-shape> functions (circle(), ellipse(), polygon(), inset()) and image URLs for non-rectangular float wrapping.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Shapes Module Level 1 / MDN Web Docs Reference
detail.technical_mechanics: Modifies the exclusion area of a floated box. Surrounding inline-level content reflows tightly along the defined shape contour rather than the traditional rectangular margin box.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Permits mini app storefronts to wrap descriptive product copy smoothly around asymmetrical catalog merchandise (e.g., shoe silhouettes, perfume bottles, badge icons).
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: The browser caches computed shape geometry per element; reflow only re-evaluates when element dimensions or float bounds change.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini app review guidelines mandate that any shape-outside: polygon(...) declaration contain no more than 32 vertices to guarantee 60fps layout passes during catalog scrolling.

title: CSS shape-margin Property: Non-Rectangular Exclusion Padding & Hit-Testing Clearance
description: Standardizes outward expansion of geometric shape boundaries, establishing dedicated clearance buffers between non-rectangular graphics and adjacent text.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Shapes Module Level 1 - Section 3 Shape Margin
detail.technical_mechanics: Applies a positive length or percentage offset to the outer perimeter of the basic-shape or alpha boundary. Inline content maintains an exact minimum clearance without altering the actual float element margin box.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Ensures readable text spacing around promotional badges and dynamic merchant logos across multi-density smartphone displays without breaking responsive grid containers.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: The margin offset calculation is vectorized in compositor memory, adding zero extra DOM nodes or paint layers.
detail.store_review_rule: Automated design linters verify that non-rectangular floating UI components specify a shape-margin of at least 8px to satisfy accessibility reading comfort guidelines.

title: CSS shape-image-threshold: Alpha Channel Luminance Extraction & Mask Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the alpha threshold cutoff used to extract wrapping contours from transparent bitmap and vector images declared in shape-outside.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Shapes Module Level 1 - Section 4 Image Thresholding
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts a <number> or <percentage> from 0.0 to 1.0 (or 0% to 100%). Pixels with an alpha channel value greater than the threshold are treated as part of the exclusion shape. Images must satisfy CORS requirements.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows mini app developers to wrap article text or checkout reviews around transparent PNG/WebP product photos dynamically without hardcoding polygon coordinates.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Prevents memory bloat by reusing image alpha data already decoded in the browser image cache for rendering.
detail.store_review_rule: Images referenced in shape-outside must be loaded with proper cross-origin headers (crossorigin='anonymous'); images failing CORS checks cause shape-outside to fall back gracefully to the rectangular margin box.

title: CSS <basic-shape> Data Type: Vector Geometry Primitives & Shared Clipping Subsystem
description: Standardizes declarative functional notation (inset, circle, ellipse, polygon) shared across shape-outside, clip-path, and offset-path CSS modules.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Shapes Module Level 1 / W3C CSS Masking Module Level 1
detail.technical_mechanics: Provides a unified vector coordinate system with relative reference boxes (margin-box, border-box, padding-box, content-box). Shapes are interpolated smoothly during CSS transitions when polygon vertex counts match.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Provides a lightweight, zero-dependency mechanism for mini apps to construct polygonal card chips, diagonal header dividers, and circular avatars without bundling heavy SVG libraries.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Basic shapes are parsed directly into C++ geometric path structures inside the WebView engine, consuming minimal RAM compared to full SVG DOM subtrees.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini app style analyzers check basic-shape declarations to ensure relative units (%, vw, vh) are properly bound to reference boxes to prevent visual clipping on varied mobile aspect ratios.

title: W3C CSS Positioned Layout Module Level 3: Sticky Viewport Pinning & Stacking Boundaries
description: Standardizes the CSS Positioned Layout specification, defining static, relative, absolute, fixed, and sticky positioning models, inset properties, and scroll container pinning.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Positioned Layout Module Level 3 - CSSWG Working Draft
detail.technical_mechanics: Establishes layout models for positioned boxes. position: sticky behaves as relative positioning until its containing block crosses a specified threshold within its nearest scrolling ancestor, where it becomes pinned in the viewport.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Provides the foundational layout contract for mini app sticky category navigation headers, floating checkout CTA buttons, and pinned filter bars without relying on fragile JavaScript scroll listeners.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Sticky positioning is calculated directly within the browser's native composited scrolling pipeline on the GPU thread, completely eliminating main-thread scroll jank and layout thrashing.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps must utilize CSS position: sticky for sticky headers rather than window.addEventListener('scroll') coordinate mutation, which degrades super app scroll performance.

title: CSS position Property Mechanics: Sticky Threshold Clamping & Containing Block Lifetime
description: Specifies property values (static, relative, absolute, fixed, sticky) and defines sticky item clamping within parent containing block boundaries.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Positioned Layout Module Level 3 / MDN Web Docs Reference
detail.technical_mechanics: A sticky element is pinned relative to its scrolling context until the bottom boundary of its parent container meets the pinned element, at which point it scrolls out of view with its parent.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows mini app product sections, group headers in chat logs, and financial transaction months to seamlessly dock at the top of the viewport and push previous sticky headers out naturally.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Prevents memory allocation by executing coordinate clamping in the compositor without creating synthetic scroll containers or detached DOM structures.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini app style linters check that parent containers enclosing position: sticky elements do not set overflow: hidden or overflow: auto inadvertently, which breaks sticky anchoring.

title: CSS Inset Offsets (top, bottom, left, right): Viewport Edge Snapping & Safe Area Alignment
description: Standardizes offset box positioning properties (top, bottom, left, right), controlling the active stickiness threshold distance from the scrolling viewport edges.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Positioned Layout Module Level 3 - Section 2 Inset Properties
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts length, percentage, or auto values. In sticky positioning, top specifies the distance from the top edge of the scroll container at which the element sticks.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows mini apps to offset sticky headers below the super app container's native title bar and notch safe areas (e.g. top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 44px)).
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Resolves percentage and calc() offsets dynamically during layout without requiring continuous recalculation during touch gestures.
detail.store_review_rule: Sticky navigation bars in mini apps must integrate CSS env(safe-area-inset-top) with top offset to avoid being obscured by native super app header chrome.

title: CSS inset Property: Flow-Agnostic Viewport Pinning & Fullscreen Modal Containment
description: Standardizes the inset shorthand property corresponding to the top, right, bottom, and left properties, establishing clean four-sided layout boundaries.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Positioned Layout Module Level 3 - Section 2.5 Inset Shorthands
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts one to four values mapping to top, right, bottom, left. Declaring position: absolute/fixed with inset: 0 cleanly binds a modal backdrop or dialog overlay to its containing block.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Provides mini app dialogs, loading scrims, and payment verification backdrops with foolproof full-bleed container coverage without hardcoding 100vw/100vh.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Avoids viewport unit recalculation bugs caused by dynamic address bar / virtual keyboard resizing on mobile platforms.
detail.store_review_rule: Modal overlay components in mini apps must use position: fixed; inset: 0 instead of width: 100vw; height: 100vh to maintain proper container containment.

title: CSS z-index Property: Stacking Context Hierarchies & Layer Sandboxing
description: Standardizes third-dimensional coordinate ordering along the z-axis, establishing strict visual layering hierarchies and isolation between mini app widgets and container chrome.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Positioned Layout Module Level 3 - Section 3 Stacking Contexts
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts integer values or auto. Non-auto integer values on positioned elements create a local stacking context, trapping all child z-index values within that subtree.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Prevents untrusted mini app UI components from rendering on top of super app security banners, native permission prompts, or payment approval sheets.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Enforces deterministic compositor layer tree generation, bounding the depth of the GPU layer hierarchy.
detail.store_review_rule: The super app container sandboxes the mini app root with isolation: isolate or an explicit container-level stacking context, ensuring mini app z-index values (even 999999) cannot occlude native host overlays.

title: CSS accent-color Property: Form Control Theming & Accessibility Contrast Sandboxing
description: Standardizes user-interface accent color specification across native form controls (checkboxes, radio buttons, range sliders, progress bars), preserving WCAG contrast ratios while harmonizing mini-app widgets with super-app host branding.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Basic User Interface Module Level 4 - Section 3 Accent Color
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts color keywords, hex, rgb/hsl, or CSS variables. When applied, user agents tint native form controls while automatically calculating accessible foreground checkmarks or indicators to guarantee high contrast.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables mini apps to adopt host super app brand palettes across form inputs without resorting to bloated, inaccessible custom JS/div recreations of HTML form controls.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Handled natively by browser graphics engines at zero JS runtime memory overhead, avoiding reflows during form interactions.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps adopting custom accent-color properties on form inputs must maintain a minimum 3:1 contrast ratio against container background surfaces to pass accessibility review.

title: CSS appearance Property: Native UI De-escalation & Secure Form Customization
description: Standardizes the appearance property, controlling whether elements are rendered using platform-native widget styling or pure CSS box models, preventing platform spoofing while enabling secure custom controls.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Basic User Interface Module Level 4 - Section 2 Appearance
detail.technical_mechanics: Supports values including auto, none, and standardized keyword values. Declaring appearance: none strips OS-native chrome from buttons, selects, and text inputs, allowing pristine, auditable CSS box rendering.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Prevents mini apps from visually imitating host OS native authentication dialogs or system biometric prompts via styled native widgets.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Reduces native widget bridge synchronization overhead between the webview rendering thread and host OS accessibility trees.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini-app form inputs and custom pickers must declare appearance: none when applying custom themes to ensure consistent touch target boundaries across heterogeneous mobile OS versions.

title: CSS caret-color Property: Input Cursor Visibility & Visual Theme Isolation
description: Standardizes the caret-color property for styling the insertion caret in editable text elements, preventing unreadable or camouflaged typing cursors in dark-mode and custom-branded mini app interfaces.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Basic User Interface Module Level 4 - Section 4 Caret Color
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts auto or valid CSS color values. Auto preserves platform default or contrasting caret behavior, while explicit colors style the blinking text cursor in inputs, textareas, and contenteditable nodes.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Protects users against invisible cursors during data entry in mini-app checkout, KYC, or messaging forms when dynamic dark/light theme switching occurs.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Rendered via the browser compositor's caret blinking timer without triggering full document style recalculation.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps implementing custom dark themes must verify caret-color contrast against input background fields; transparent carets or zero-contrast carets are flagged as usability defects.

title: CSS cursor Property: Pointer Affordance Taxonomy & Clickjacking Prevention
description: Standardizes mouse/pointer cursor visual affordances, preventing malicious mini apps from using custom image cursors or deceptive system cursors to misrepresent interactive surfaces and execute clickjacking.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Basic User Interface Module Level 4 - Section 5 Cursors
detail.technical_mechanics: Defines standardized pointer keywords (default, pointer, wait, text, not-allowed) and url() image cursors with fallback keywords and hotspot coordinates.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Crucial on foldable, desktop-mode (Samsung DeX), and web-based super app runtimes where arbitrary cursor: none or offset custom url() cursors could disguise active payment buttons.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Custom cursor images are bounded by browser dimension limits (typically 32x32 to 128x128 pixels) to prevent GPU texture exhaustion.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps running on pointer-enabled super app environments are prohibited from declaring cursor: none or custom url() cursors outside bounded canvas gaming contexts.

title: CSS user-select Property: Text Selection Hygiene & Accidental Drag Prevention
description: Standardizes text and content selection controls, preventing accidental text-highlight drag operations on touch-based mobile UI controls while preserving copyability on legal disclosures and transaction references.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Basic User Interface Module Level 4 - Section 6 Selection Control
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts none, auto, text, and all. user-select: none suppresses native text selection highlights, touch-callout context menus, and drag gestures on UI chrome.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Ensures mini app bottom sheets, tabs, floating action buttons, and modal dialogs feel responsive and native by preventing clumsy multi-second text selection during touch drags.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Eliminates memory overhead of creating selection ranges and DOM highlight overlays during rapid scrolling and touch manipulation.
detail.store_review_rule: Interactive mini-app controls (buttons, tabs, badges) should declare user-select: none, but order confirmation codes, receipt IDs, and customer service contact details must retain user-select: text.

title: CSS writing-mode Property: Block-Flow Direction & Multilingual Layout Sandboxing
description: Standardizes block-flow direction and inline text orientation across horizontal (horizontal-tb) and vertical (vertical-rl, vertical-lr) writing systems, enabling native East Asian and internationalized super-app experiences.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Writing Modes Level 4 - Section 3 Inline-Axis and Block-Axis
detail.technical_mechanics: Defines horizontal-tb, vertical-rl, vertical-lr, and sideways modes. Automatically re-orients inline and block axes, transforming physical width/height mappings to logical inline-size/block-size.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows mini apps serving traditional Japanese, Chinese, and Mongolian vertical literature, menus, or receipts to render correctly without fragile CSS transform hacks.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Browser layout engines natively construct vertical formatting contexts without duplicating rendering pipelines or allocating additional display buffers.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps deploying vertical writing modes must utilize CSS logical properties (margin-block, padding-inline) to prevent container layout clipping on diverse device aspect ratios.

title: CSS direction Property: Inline Base Direction & Right-To-Left UI Orchestration
description: Standardizes inline base direction (ltr vs rtl) for text, table column progression, and overflow alignment, orchestrating right-to-left layout transformations for Arabic, Hebrew, and Persian mini app deployments.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Writing Modes Level 4 - Section 2 Inline Direction
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts ltr or rtl. Controls the base directionality of inline formatting contexts, governing bidirectional algorithm resolution, text-align defaults, and horizontal scroll origin positioning.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables seamless localization of mini apps across Middle East and North Africa (MENA) markets, aligning navigation bars, back buttons, and input fields to host super-app RTL conventions.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Inherits down the DOM tree with minimal cascade cost, avoiding script-based UI re-ordering.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps claiming RTL locale support must configure the HTML dir attribute or CSS direction property at the root container to ensure mirrored navigation and icon alignment.

title: CSS unicode-bidi Property: BiDi Isolation & Trojan Source Injection Defense
description: Standardizes bidirectional text embedding and isolation (isolate, isolate-override, plaintext), preventing user-generated or merchant-supplied RTL text from visually corrupting adjacent LTR financial numbers, currency symbols, and account IDs.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Writing Modes Level 4 - Section 2.2 Bidirectional Isolation
detail.technical_mechanics: Values include normal, embed, isolate, bidi-override, isolate-override, and plaintext. The isolate value creates a directional boundary isolating internal BiDi resolution from the parent text stream.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Shields super-app transaction summaries and order review sheets against 'Trojan Source' visual spoofing where injected RTL formatting characters reverse price totals or account numbers.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Enforced during text shaping and HarfBuzz glyph positioning without measurable runtime CPU latency.
detail.store_review_rule: Dynamic strings in mini-app financial transactions, merchant names, and order references must be wrapped in elements with unicode-bidi: isolate (or HTML <bdi>) to prevent directional spillover attacks.

title: CSS text-orientation Property: Vertical Script Glyph Rotation & Typographic Integrity
description: Standardizes the orientation of glyphs in vertical writing modes (mixed, upright, sideways), ensuring Latin acronyms, phone numbers, and East Asian ideographs render with correct typographic conventions.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Writing Modes Level 4 - Section 5 Glyph Orientation
detail.technical_mechanics: Supports mixed (vertical ideographs upright, horizontal scripts rotated 90 degrees), upright (all characters laid out upright along vertical baseline), and sideways (all text rotated 90 degrees).
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Guarantees that mini apps displaying digital menus, vertical coupons, and cultural event posters render mixed Japanese/Chinese/English text legibly.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Integrated directly into OpenType font layout tables (vmtx, VORG) by the browser font rendering engine.
detail.store_review_rule: Vertical mini-app UI components displaying international identifiers or Latin currencies must declare text-orientation: mixed to prevent unreadable rotated East Asian characters.

title: CSS text-combine-upright Property: Tate-chu-yoko Compact Number Sandboxing
description: Standardizes horizontal character combination inside vertical text streams (Tate-chu-yoko), compressing 2-to-4 digit numbers into the space of a single vertical ideographic character cell.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Writing Modes Level 4 - Section 5.3 Combination in Vertical Flow
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts none, all, or digits [2-4]. Squeezes adjacent horizontal characters into a square bounding box equal to one ideographic character pitch within vertical text.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Essential for vertical mini apps presenting calendar dates, day numbers (e.g. 25日), store floor numbers (e.g. 3F), and discount percentages (e.g. 50%) in East Asian retail super apps.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Eliminates manual SVG/image replacements for combined numbers, saving DOM nodes and network bandwidth.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps formatted in vertical writing modes must utilize text-combine-upright: digits 2 for two-digit dates and hours to maintain consistent vertical column line height and spacing.

title: CSS @keyframes Rule: Declarative Kinetic Interpolation & Compositor Pipeline
description: Standardizes declarative multi-stage animation sequences via @keyframes rules, establishing isolated kinetic states that browser rendering engines can offload directly to GPU compositor threads.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Animations Level 1 - Section 2 Keyframes
detail.technical_mechanics: Defines percentages (0% to 100%) or from/to keywords mapping property values at intermediate animation waypoints. Enables hardware-accelerated transform and opacity interpolation without main-thread JS overhead.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables silky-smooth skeleton loaders, shimmer effects, and pull-to-refresh indicators in mini apps that run at 60/120fps without locking the main JavaScript event loop.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Composited keyframe tracks run on dedicated GPU threads, remaining fluid even when heavy business logic or API parsing occupies the main thread.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini-app @keyframes rules must strictly animate compositor-friendly properties (transform, opacity, filter) rather than reflow-inducing geometry (width, height, top, margin).

title: CSS animation-name Property: Kinetic Keyframe Binding & Namespace Conflict Prevention
description: Standardizes the binding of specific @keyframes rules to elements via animation-name, enforcing modular CSS scoping and preventing collision with super-app host framework animation registries.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Animations Level 1 - Section 3.1 Animation Name
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts none, custom ident names, or comma-separated lists for multiple concurrent animations. Matches against accessible @keyframes definitions in the cascade scope.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Prevents global CSS class or animation-name collisions between third-party mini apps and the enclosing super-app container shell (e.g. host modal fade-ins vs mini-app button pulses).
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Detaching or overriding animation-name immediately halts animation execution and releases compositor thread tracks.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini-app build pipelines should prefix custom animation identifiers or encapsulate them inside Shadow DOM / CSS Modules to avoid accidental naming collisions with host chrome styles.

title: CSS animation-duration Property: Temporal Bounding & Battery Drain Throttling
description: Standardizes the length of time an animation takes to complete one cycle via animation-duration, establishing normative temporal boundaries that prevent excessive GPU wakeups and battery drain on mobile devices.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Animations Level 1 - Section 3.2 Animation Duration
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts time values in seconds (s) or milliseconds (ms). Non-zero durations activate time interpolation; 0s renders final state instantaneously.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows container governance to audit long-running and looping animations in mini apps, enforcing aggressive throttling when the host app detects low-power mode or background tab state.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Prevents runaway CPU/GPU timer loops by tying animation cycles to browser display refresh sync (vsync).
detail.store_review_rule: Micro-interaction animations in mini apps must not exceed a duration of 500ms; looping ambient animations must automatically pause when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is requested.

title: CSS animation-timing-function Property: Physics Easing & Motion Ergonomics
description: Standardizes acceleration curves via cubic-bezier, linear, and steps timing functions, creating natural ergonomic physics for drawer transitions, bottom sheets, and interactive dismissals in super-app mini apps.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Animations Level 1 - Section 3.3 Animation Timing Function
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts keywords (ease, linear, ease-in, ease-out, ease-in-out), cubic-bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2), and steps(n, jump-term). Governs rate of property progression across the duration interval.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Harmonizes mini-app modal sheet presentation physics with the super-app's native OS gestures (e.g. standard decelerate cubic-bezier(0.0, 0.0, 0.2, 1) on Android/iOS).
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Mathematical spline calculations are precomputed into lookup tables on compositor threads, incurring zero runtime layout calculation cost.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini-app navigational transitions and bottom-sheet drawers should utilize standard ease-out or platform-aligned cubic-bezier curves rather than jarring linear motion.

title: CSS animation-play-state Property: Runtime Lifecycle Pausing & Power Conservation
description: Standardizes programmatic pausing and resuming of animations via animation-play-state, enabling super-app webviews to instantaneously freeze background mini app animations during modal sheets, payment flows, or thermal throttling.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Animations Level 1 - Section 3.8 Animation Play State
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts running or paused. Switching to paused freezes the animation at its current exact interpolated frame, maintaining visual layout state without tearing or resetting to start values.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Gives super-app host containers a zero-JS declarative lever to pause all mini-app CSS animations when an OS phone call arrives, a native camera barcode scanner opens, or a biometric payment sheet appears.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Freezing running animations immediately disengages compositor thread timer ticks, dropping GPU utilization to 0% during container overlays.
detail.store_review_rule: The super app container may inject a container-wide style rule (* { animation-play-state: paused !important; }) during active modal payment authorization to eliminate competing GPU load.

title: CSS overflow-anchor Property: Layout Shift (CLS) Elimination & Scroll Pinning Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the scroll anchoring algorithm via overflow-anchor (auto vs none), allowing super-app scrollable webviews to automatically adjust scroll position and eliminate Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) when asynchronous ad cards, dynamic media banners, or live chat bubbles insert above the viewport.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Scroll Anchoring Module Level 1 - Section 3 Suppression of Scroll Anchoring
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts auto or none. By default (auto), user agents track an anchor node within the scroll container's visible bounds and automatically compensate scroll offsets when content above the anchor resizes or mutates. Setting none disables anchoring for specialized scrolling widgets like infinite feeds or virtualized carousels.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Prevents disruptive visual jumping and inadvertent mis-clicks (e.g. clicking unintended purchase buttons) in mini-app checkout screens and content feeds when lazy-loaded images, merchant banners, or dynamic badges render asynchronously.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Operates at the compositor and layout engine level with zero JavaScript overhead, avoiding expensive manual DOM measurement loops (getBoundingClientRect) and scroll listener re-calculations.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini-app scrollable containers that stream dynamic content must allow default overflow-anchor: auto or explicitly manage virtualized pinning to keep Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) scores below 0.1.

title: CSS pointer-events Property: Hit-Testing De-escalation & Transparent Overlay Security
description: Standardizes hit-testing target determination via pointer-events (none vs auto), enabling super apps and mini apps to render floating status badges, decorative visual overlays, and non-blocking floating HUDs without intercepting underlying user interactions or enabling clickjacking.

detail.specification: SVG / CSS Basic User Interface / Pointer Events Specifications - pointer-events Property
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts none, auto, and specialized SVG hit-testing values (visiblePainted, fill, stroke, all). When set to none, the element is transparent to mouse, touch, and stylus hit testing, allowing pointer events to seamlessly fall through to underlying DOM nodes.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Essential for super-app overlay chrome (watermarks, developer debug HUDs, security indicators, floating container badges) to exist visually above a mini app without blocking user checkout taps or modal interactions.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Evaluated during native hit-testing phases without triggering JavaScript event dispatch queues, eliminating hit-test dispatch bottlenecks during rapid pointer movements.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps using full-viewport transparent or semi-transparent decorative elements must declare pointer-events: none to prevent accidental click interception or malicious clickjacking of underlying UI.

title: CSS touch-action Property: Declarative Gesture Filtering & Host Dismissal Arbitration
description: Standardizes declarative touchscreen gesture filtering via touch-action (none, pan-x, pan-y, manipulation), resolving conflicts between mini-app internal gestures (canvases, sliders, maps) and super-app host container navigation gestures (edge swipe-to-back, pull-to-refresh).

detail.specification: W3C Pointer Events Level 3 - Section 5.2 The touch-action CSS Property
detail.technical_mechanics: Declares which touch gestures the browser engine may handle directly. Setting manipulation disables double-tap to zoom to eliminate 300ms click delay. Setting pan-x or pan-y restricts panning to a single axis, passing perpendicular swipe gestures directly to the container.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows mini-app interactive surfaces (e.g. signature pads, interactive product customizers, horizontal card decks) to disable default scrolling (touch-action: none or pan-x) while allowing host container edge gestures for dismissing mini apps.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Declarative gesture filtering allows the compositor thread to immediately determine whether to execute native gestures without waiting for main-thread touch event listeners, eliminating scroll lag.
detail.store_review_rule: Interactive mini-app widgets like digital signature pads, mini-games, and image croppers must declare touch-action: none or manipulation to guarantee responsive touch tracking and prevent accidental container navigation.

title: PointerEvent.pointerType Property: Hardware Input Device Disambiguation & Ergonomic Sandboxing
description: Standardizes runtime identification of physical pointing device hardware via PointerEvent.pointerType ('mouse', 'pen', 'touch'), enabling mini apps to adapt touch target sizes, hover states, and input precision dynamically without brittle user-agent sniffing.

detail.specification: W3C Pointer Events Level 3 - Section 5.1.1 PointerEvent Attributes: pointerType
detail.technical_mechanics: Returns a DOMString indicating the physical device type that generated the event: 'mouse' for traditional desktop mice/trackpads, 'pen' for active/passive digital styluses, or 'touch' for direct finger contact on touchscreen surfaces.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables multi-form-factor super apps (smartphones, tablets, foldables, POS terminals) to adjust mini-app form control hit targets (e.g. 48px minimum for 'touch' vs 24px for 'mouse') and activate stylus pressure features in e-contract signing.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Read directly from the native input event payload in O(1) time without triggering DOM reflows or hardware query roundtrips.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps must not disable mouse or stylus interactions based on mobile UA strings; input handling must inspect PointerEvent.pointerType to provide adaptive hit testing across foldables, tablets, and peripheral-attached devices.

title: PointerEvent.isPrimary Property: Multi-Touch Primary Pointer Arbitration & Race Condition Defense
description: Standardizes multi-touch sequence arbitration via PointerEvent.isPrimary, identifying the active master pointer among concurrent touch contacts to prevent multi-touch event race conditions, double-submission bugs, and rogue touch injection.

detail.specification: W3C Pointer Events Level 3 - Section 5.1.1 PointerEvent Attributes: isPrimary
detail.technical_mechanics: A boolean attribute indicating whether the pointer represents the primary contact of a multi-touch sequence (e.g. the first finger touching the screen). Subsequent simultaneous finger contacts have isPrimary set to false until all existing pointers are lifted.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Prevents critical payment and transaction race conditions in mini apps, such as simultaneous two-finger taps on 'Confirm Payment' and 'Cancel Order' buttons firing duplicate API requests.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Maintained by the browser platform's native input pipeline, allowing lightweight O(1) filtering of secondary touch contacts during complex multi-finger gestures.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini-app transaction confirmation buttons and checkout flows must verify event.isPrimary === true or enforce single-pointer event handling to prevent multi-tap financial race conditions.

title: CSS initial-letter Property: Editorial Drop Caps & First-Letter Baselines Sandboxing
description: Standardizes editorial drop-cap and sunken-cap formatting via initial-letter, enabling mini-app news readers, content publishers, and e-commerce catalogs to achieve precise multi-line typographic scale without brittle float hacks, negative margins, or vertical alignment bugs across mobile viewports.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Inline Layout Module Level 3 - Section 6 Initial Letters
detail.technical_mechanics: Specifies sizing and sinkage for initial letters (e.g. initial-letter: 3 2 sinks the letter 2 lines while making it 3 lines tall). Automatically computes font size and aligns the top cap-height and bottom baseline with surrounding text lines.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Eliminates common layout breakages in news and luxury brand mini apps where manual float: left hacks with line-height hacks cause text collisions and clipping across dynamic system font scaling.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Computed natively within the inline formatting context by the browser layout engine, avoiding expensive JavaScript text metrics measuring and DOM mutations.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps rendering editorial drop caps must use initial-letter or verified responsive CSS rather than fixed-pixel absolute positioning, ensuring compatibility with container user-defined text scaling (dynamic type).

title: CSS dominant-baseline Property: Multi-Script Baseline Harmonization & Mixed-Alphabet Stability
description: Standardizes the dominant typographic baseline via dominant-baseline across Latin, Asian, Indic, and Arabic scripts (alphabetic, ideographic, hanging, mathematical, central), ensuring stable vertical alignment in multilingual super-app mini-app catalogs.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Inline Layout Module Level 3 - Section 4 Baseline Alignment
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts auto, alphabetic, ideographic, hanging, mathematical, central, middle, text-top, text-bottom. Re-scales the parent inline box's dominant baseline table, providing an explicit alignment anchor for child inline boxes and SVG text elements.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Critical for cross-border super-app catalogs (e.g. SEA multi-language platforms mixing Vietnamese, Chinese, Thai, and English) to prevent vertical jitter and baseline misalignments between prices, currency signs, and product titles.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Resolved strictly during inline text layout without requiring external font metrics measurement scripts, preserving 60fps rendering during list scrolling.
detail.store_review_rule: Multilingual mini apps rendering mixed-script badges or price tags must use standard baseline alignment properties to guarantee vertical alignment parity across CJK and Latin scripts.

title: CSS alignment-baseline Property: Inline Box & Icon Baseline Alignment Sandboxing
description: Standardizes alignment of inline boxes, status badges, and embedded SVG icons to the dominant baseline via alignment-baseline, eliminating 1px optical misalignments in mini-app headers, transaction receipts, and verification badges.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Inline Layout Module Level 3 - Section 4 Baseline Alignment
detail.technical_mechanics: Specifies how an inline box or SVG element aligns to its parent's baseline table (baseline, top, before-edge, text-before-edge, middle, central, after-edge, text-after-edge, ideographic, alphabetic, hanging, mathematical).
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Prevents micro-jitter and misalignment of verified merchant icons, telco carrier badges, and security lock symbols embedded next to mini-app titles and transaction numbers.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Executed during glyph compositing in the native layout engine without triggering style recalculation cascades or reflow invalidation.
detail.store_review_rule: Inline status icons and badges in mini-app checkout headers must align to the textual baseline using standard alignment properties, avoiding negative margin workarounds that break across screen densities.

title: CSS ruby-position Property: Phonetic Annotation Placement & Asian Localization Sandboxing
description: Standardizes placement of phonetic pronunciation annotations (furigana, pinyin, bopomofo) via ruby-position (over, under, alternate, inter-character), enabling mini-app financial contracts, legal terms, and multilingual education apps to render Japanese and Chinese typography natively.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Ruby Layout Module Level 1 - Section 4 Ruby Positioning
detail.technical_mechanics: Specifies where the ruby text container (<rt>) appears relative to the ruby base container (<rb>). In horizontal text, 'over' renders annotations above the characters; 'under' renders below. In vertical writing modes, annotations automatically track right/left according to script conventions.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Essential for East Asian financial leasing mini apps, official administrative forms, and banking mini apps where precise pronunciation of legal names, unfamiliar kanji/hanzi terminology, and compliance clauses is legally mandated.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Integrated directly into the text layout tree, avoiding manual positioned-span hacks that bloat DOM memory and cause text selection corruption.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps targeting East Asian locales that provide phonetic annotations for legal names or contracts must utilize semantic <ruby> and <rt> markup with standard ruby-position styling rather than detached overlay divs.

title: CSS ruby-align Property: Phonetic Text Distribution & Typographic Overflow Prevention
description: Standardizes horizontal distribution and justification of ruby text over base characters via ruby-align (start, center, space-between, space-around), preventing phonetic text overlap, clipping, or unintended line-overflow in localized super-app interfaces.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Ruby Layout Module Level 1 - Section 5 Ruby Alignment
detail.technical_mechanics: Defines how ruby text is distributed across the ruby base when text lengths differ. 'space-around' distributes extra space evenly around glyphs according to traditional Japanese typography; 'space-between' aligns to edge boundaries; 'center' centers shorter annotations.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Ensures compact financial tables, mini-app navigation tabs, and dialog buttons render Japanese and Chinese phonetic annotations cleanly without text collision or horizontal overflow.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Handled within inline box layout passes without triggering cross-container reflows or requiring client-side layout calculation scripts.
detail.store_review_rule: Phonetic annotations in mini apps must declare appropriate ruby-align rules to prevent clipping or visual overlaps in constrained UI surfaces such as bottom sheets and modal confirmation cards.

title: CSS background-clip Property: Painting Area Sandboxing & Typographic Masking
description: Standardizes the boundary of the background painting area via background-clip (border-box, padding-box, content-box, text), allowing super apps and mini apps to contain decorative gradients and brand fills within explicit box-model boundaries or clip them into typographic text shapes.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Backgrounds and Borders Module Level 3 - Section 3.7 Background Clip
detail.technical_mechanics: Controls whether an element's background extends beneath its border (border-box), stops at the inside edge of the border (padding-box), is confined to the content area (content-box), or is masked by foreground text glyphs (text).
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables mini apps to render rich gradient text headings, decorative voucher labels, and clean translucent borders without bleeding backgrounds behind border lines or generating multi-layer DOM wrappers.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Computed in the paint phase using GPU raster clipping masks, avoiding separate DOM element nodes or heavyweight canvas redraw operations.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps adopting translucent borders or gradient typography must use standard background-clip properties rather than nested wrapper divs, preserving clean DOM hierarchy and low memory usage.

title: CSS border-image Shorthand: 9-Slice Decorative Framing & Scalable Skin Sandboxing
description: Standardizes 9-slice raster and vector decorative framing via the border-image shorthand, enabling mini-app branded cards, promotional coupons, and game dialog bubbles to scale smoothly across screen densities without multi-image patchwork.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Backgrounds and Borders Module Level 3 - Section 6 Border Image
detail.technical_mechanics: Shorthand combining border-image-source, border-image-slice, border-image-width, border-image-outset, and border-image-repeat. Splits a source image into 9 distinct slices (4 corners, 4 edges, 1 center), stretching or repeating edge slices while keeping corners invariant.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows mini apps (especially e-commerce vouchers, loyalty tickets, and interactive mini-games) to render ornate, custom branded frames and receipt borders using a single compact image asset.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Caches the sliced bitmap or SVG vector in GPU texture memory, avoiding multiple layout re-computations or complex SVG DOM injections.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps using custom decorative coupon or frame styling must implement CSS border-image rather than 9 separate DOM elements, reducing DOM tree depth and paint complexity.

title: CSS border-image-slice Property: 9-Slice Corner Partitioning & Fill Governance
description: Standardizes the partitioning of border images via border-image-slice into 4 corner and 4 edge regions, including the fill keyword to preserve the middle image slice as a background fill for scalable card containers.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Backgrounds and Borders Module Level 3 - Section 6.2 Border Image Slicing
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts 1 to 4 inward offset values (numbers representing raster pixels or vector coordinates, or percentages) plus an optional fill keyword. When fill is present, the center slice is rendered as the element's interior background fill.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables mini apps to implement dynamically sized modal cards, speech bubbles, and promotional gift containers that stretch vertically and horizontally while preserving corner radius and artwork.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Executed directly by browser graphics rasterizers, avoiding JavaScript element resize observers and manual slice repositioning.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps employing resizable card containers with custom art borders must specify valid border-image-slice parameters to prevent image distortion and layout reflows during viewport transitions.

title: CSS border-radius Property: Surface Curvature Geometry & Host Design Token Sandboxing
description: Standardizes rounded corner geometry via border-radius (single and dual elliptical radii), enabling mini-app surfaces, buttons, and cards to harmonize with super-app host design systems (e.g. iOS rounded cards, Material 3 shapes, HarmonyOS rounded surfaces) without clipping glitches.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Backgrounds and Borders Module Level 3 - Section 5 Rounded Corners
detail.technical_mechanics: Defines horizontal and vertical radii for each of the four corners (top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left). Automatically scales corner radii down proportionally when the sum of adjacent radii exceeds border box dimensions, guaranteeing mathematically smooth curves.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows the super-app host container to inject platform-consistent border-radius design tokens (e.g. 16px bottom-sheet top corners, 12px card corners, 8px button corners) into mini-app webviews for native aesthetic parity.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Rendered via hardware-accelerated anti-aliased geometry shaders, clipping child contents cleanly when combined with overflow: hidden.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini-app modal sheets and floating cards must adopt container design token variables for border-radius to preserve platform consistency with host super-app chrome.

title: CSS box-decoration-break Property: Fragmented Box Styling & Multiline Inline Sandboxing
description: Standardizes styling behavior across fragmented box fragments (inline line breaks, multi-column fragmentation) via box-decoration-break (slice vs clone), ensuring backgrounds, borders, padding, and border-radius render completely around each line fragment in wrapped mini-app text.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Fragmentation Module Level 3 / CSS Backgrounds and Borders - Box Decoration Break
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts slice (default, styles are applied to the box as a whole and sliced across breaks) or clone (each box fragment receives its own independent border, border-radius, background, and padding).
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables mini apps to render multi-line highlighted product titles, promotional discount tags, and legal compliance disclaimers where inline pill badges wrap across two lines while maintaining rounded pill borders on both segments.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Handled during fragment tree generation in the layout pipeline without needing JavaScript span segmentation or manual line-wrapping observers.
detail.store_review_rule: Inline promotional tags and badges that may wrap across lines on narrow mobile viewports must declare box-decoration-break: clone to avoid raw un-padded cut-offs at line boundaries.

title: CSS image-set() Functional Notation: Resolution-Aware Asset Selection & Bandwidth Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the W3C CSS Images Module Level 4 image-set() functional notation, enabling declarative negotiation of responsive image assets based on client device pixel ratio (DPR) and image format support (e.g. AVIF, WebP, PNG) without JavaScript runtime overhead.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Images Module Level 4 - Section 4.1 Resolution Negotiation: the image-set() notation
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts a comma-separated list of image candidate URLs paired with resolution descriptors (1x, 2x, 3x, or explicit dpi) and optional type() MIME format strings, allowing the host user agent to select the optimal raster asset matching the physical screen density.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Prevents mini apps from downloading oversized 3x/4x retina graphical assets on low-tier or bandwidth-constrained mobile devices, cutting image data consumption by up to 60% in cellular data-saver modes.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Executed during stylesheet cascade parsing before image subresources are fetched; prevents unnecessary texture allocation in GPU backing memory.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini-app packages deploying custom raster UI assets (banners, icons, game HUD skins) exceeding 100KB must declare image-set() resolution variants to satisfy store performance and low-bandwidth certification.

title: CSS object-fit Property: Replaced Element Box Sizing & Aspect Ratio Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the object-fit property for replaced elements (img, video, canvas), defining how content is fitted into containing box dimensions while preserving intrinsic aspect ratios and preventing layout distortion.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Images Module Level 3 - Section 5.1 Sizing Objects: the object-fit property
