detail.technical_mechanics: Supports contain (scales object preserving aspect ratio inside box), cover (fills entire box clipping excess), fill (stretches to fill box), none (preserves intrinsic size), and scale-down (smaller of none or contain).
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enforces consistent e-commerce product thumbnail grids, user profile avatars, and livestream video tiles inside super-app catalogs, eliminating visual distortion caused by varying partner image dimensions.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Computed directly in the compositing layer during box layout without JavaScript DOM measurements or wrapper element manipulations.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini app catalog lists and media cards rendering third-party merchant images must declare object-fit: contain or object-fit: cover to prevent aspect ratio deformation and layout shifts.

title: CSS object-position Property: Visual Alignment & Focus Point Sandboxing
description: Standardizes alignment coordinates of replaced element content within its box when scaled via object-fit, allowing focal point preservation (e.g. centering human faces or product branding).

detail.specification: W3C CSS Images Module Level 3 - Section 5.2 Positioning Objects: the object-position property
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts 1 to 4 values specifying 2D horizontal and vertical positioning offsets relative to the edges of the element box, utilizing length, percentage, or keyword tokens (top, center, bottom, left, right).
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Ensures critical visual regions (e.g. KYC document passport photos, promotional voucher QR codes) remain fully visible within responsive containing cards across heterogeneous viewport sizes.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Processed on the compositor thread without requiring layout recalculation or DOM tree alterations.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps cropping promotional banners or partner brand logos dynamically must provide object-position alignment rules to ensure branding and legal disclaimer legibility across responsive widths.

title: CSS image-rendering Property: Raster Scaling Algorithm & Pixel Art Sandboxing
description: Standardizes image-rendering directives, instructing the browser graphics engine whether to prioritize smooth bilinear interpolation or pixelated nearest-neighbor sampling when scaling raster artwork and canvas elements.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Images Module Level 3 - Section 5.3 Scaling Images: the image-rendering property
detail.technical_mechanics: Supports auto (default bi-linear smoothing), crisp-edges (preserves contrast and edges for diagrams/barcodes), and pixelated (nearest-neighbor scaling preserving sharp pixel boundaries without blurring).
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Critical for H5 mini games, pixel art graphics, dynamic barcode/QR code generation, and low-resolution data visualizations, preventing blurry QR codes that fail scanner recognition at retail checkout.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Directly guides the texture sampler algorithm in GPU shaders (GL_NEAREST vs GL_LINEAR) without added memory overhead.
detail.store_review_rule: Payment and ticketing mini apps rendering QR codes or barcodes on HTML5 canvas elements must apply image-rendering: pixelated or crisp-edges to guarantee POS optical scanner legibility.

title: CSS conic-gradient() Functional Notation: Angular Sweep Shading & Chart Sandboxing
description: Standardizes conic-gradient() notation, creating color transitions rotated around a central focal point, enabling high-performance circular charts, color wheels, and loading rings without SVG DOM nodes or raster image transfers.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Images Module Level 4 - Section 3.4 Conic Gradients: the conic-gradient() notation
detail.technical_mechanics: Takes an optional starting angle and center position followed by color-stop lists with angular transitions (deg, grad, rad, turn, or percentages representing full circle proportions).
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows mini apps to generate complex progress gauges, financial expenditure pie charts, and spinner animations purely via CSS, saving up to 50KB in external charting library bundles.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Synthesized directly on the GPU canvas rasterizer; eliminates heavy SVG DOM node trees and JavaScript canvas repaint loops.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps displaying circular progress indicators or financial breakdown charts are encouraged to utilize CSS conic-gradient() over heavyweight JavaScript chart libraries to maintain optimal launch latency.

title: CSS @page At-Rule: Paged Media Layout & Printable Voucher Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the CSS Paged Media Module Level 3 @page at-rule, allowing mini apps to declare page dimensions, margins, orientation, and margin boxes for formatted printable documents (invoices, receipts, boarding passes).

detail.specification: W3C CSS Paged Media Module Level 3 - Section 3 The Page Model & @page Rule
detail.technical_mechanics: Defines page box layout for printed media, accepting size (dimensions, paper sizes like A4, orientation keywords portrait/landscape), margin properties, and pseudo-class selectors (:first, :left, :right, :blank).
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables retail, utility, and ticketing mini apps to produce standardized, print-ready PDF invoices and official receipts directly from the super-app WebView without external PDF rendering services.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Evaluated exclusively when the media type matches print or during window.print() dispatch, consuming zero memory during normal interactive browsing.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps providing formal invoicing, tax receipts, or event ticket print features must specify valid @page rules with bounded margins (min 10mm) to prevent printer truncation across standard paper sizes.

title: CSS break-inside Property: Page & Multi-Column Fragmentation Containment
description: Standardizes the break-inside property from CSS Fragmentation Module Level 3, controlling page, column, and region breaks within an element box to prevent awkward fragmentation of table rows, receipts, or voucher cards.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Fragmentation Module Level 3 - Section 3.1 Page/Column Breaks: the break-inside property
detail.technical_mechanics: Supports auto (allows breaks), avoid (avoids fragmentation within the box), avoid-page (avoids page breaks), and avoid-column (avoids column fragmentation).
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Guarantees that transactional itemized receipt rows, barcode slips, and legal signature sections remain atomic and are not sliced horizontally across physical page boundaries.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Enforced by the layout engine's fragmentation tree generator during pagination without DOM restructuring.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini-app billing summaries and printable receipt cards must declare break-inside: avoid to guarantee document integrity during PDF export and printing.

title: CSS break-before Property: Structural Pagination & Sectional Break Governance
description: Standardizes the break-before property, specifying how page, column, or region breaks occur immediately before the generated box, ensuring clean multi-page document separation.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Fragmentation Module Level 3 - Section 3.1 Page/Column Breaks: the break-before property
detail.technical_mechanics: Supports auto, avoid, avoid-page, page, always, left, right, recto, verso, column, and avoid-column, orchestrating deterministic pagination flow.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows complex mini-app reports (e.g. monthly enterprise telecom expense breakdowns, medical lab test panels) to separate distinct chapters and summary tables onto dedicated fresh pages.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Executed during pagination pass; replaces deprecated legacy CSS 2 page-break-before rules with unified fragmentation semantics.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini-app reporting modules generating multi-page printable summaries must utilize standardized break-before instead of legacy page-break-before properties.

title: CSS break-after Property: Trailing Page Separation & Document Delimitation
description: Standardizes the break-after property, determining whether and how page or column breaks are inserted immediately following an element's generated box.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Fragmentation Module Level 3 - Section 3.1 Page/Column Breaks: the break-after property
detail.technical_mechanics: Provides identical values to break-before (auto, avoid, page, always, left, right, column), enforcing page termination after cover pages, summaries, or disclaimers.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables voucher mini apps to isolate tear-away coupon stubs or terms and conditions appendices onto separate print pages.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Native fragmentation tree control handled efficiently by the browser compositor during print spooling.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps must not use empty spacers with fixed heights to force page breaks; declarative break-after properties must be used.

title: Window.print() API: Native Print Dispatch & Modal Dialog Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the Window.print() method, opening the host operating system's native print spooler / PDF exporter dialog and triggering window.onbeforeprint and window.onafterprint lifecycle events.

detail.specification: HTML Living Standard - Section 7.7.3 Printing: the print() method
detail.technical_mechanics: Synchronously pauses script execution in the current window while dispatching the platform print UI. Dispatches beforeprint and afterprint events, enabling mini apps to dynamically prepare print DOM representations.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Provides a zero-dependency path for users to save PDF vouchers and print tax invoices directly from super-app mini apps without requiring third-party native plugin installations.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Host super-app container must mediate print requests, ensuring unverified mini apps cannot invoke print() in continuous loops to freeze user interaction (DoS attack mitigation).
detail.store_review_rule: Invocations of window.print() must be tied directly to a user activation gesture (click/tap) and rate-limited to 1 call per 5 seconds to prevent host freeze.

title: HTML Microdata Standard: In-DOM Machine-Readable Semantic Metadata
description: Standardizes the HTML Living Standard Microdata specification, providing machine-readable annotations directly within HTML elements to describe items, properties, and typed schemas for super-app catalog indexing and search discovery.

detail.specification: HTML Living Standard - Section 5.1 Microdata Overview & Data Model
detail.technical_mechanics: Defines a lightweight name-value pair metadata model embedded directly into DOM trees via global attributes (itemscope, itemtype, itemprop, itemid, itemref), enabling crawlers and super-app indexers to extract structured product, event, or review objects.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows the super-app global search engine and catalog crawler to extract mini-app capabilities, product prices, restaurant menus, and service booking slots directly from pre-rendered DOM trees without external API handshakes.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: In-memory extraction executed on background crawler threads; zero memory impact on interactive client rendering.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps exposing search-indexed public catalogs (e.g. food delivery, movie tickets, hotels) must implement valid Microdata schemas to qualify for global super-app spotlight placement.

title: HTML itemscope Attribute: Entity Boundary & Item Instantiation Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the boolean itemscope global attribute, establishing a new discrete semantic item boundary in the DOM hierarchy for structured metadata encapsulation.

detail.specification: HTML Living Standard - Section 5.2 Microdata Attributes: itemscope
detail.technical_mechanics: When placed on an HTML element, creates an anonymous or typed entity item, scoping subsequent descendant itemprop declarations to this specific entity.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Prevents property leakage and entity pollution across multi-item catalog cards (e.g. distinguishing a merchant's store profile entity from individual product items displayed on the same page).
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Handled during standard HTML DOM construction without overhead.
detail.store_review_rule: Every mini-app structured catalog item must declare itemscope on its outermost container element to guarantee clean entity boundary parsing by the super app indexer.

title: HTML itemtype Attribute: Schema Classification & Vocabulary Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the itemtype global attribute, assigning a globally unique URL vocabulary schema (e.g. Schema.org Product, Event, Offer) to an itemscope entity.

detail.specification: HTML Living Standard - Section 5.2 Microdata Attributes: itemtype
detail.technical_mechanics: Specifies valid absolute URLs representing defined vocabularies (predominantly Schema.org schemas). An element declaring itemtype must also declare itemscope.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables the super-app catalog to map third-party mini-app inventory into unified native categories (e.g. FoodEstablishment, BusTrip, MovieReservation), standardizing native card previews.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Read statically during indexing; no client runtime state overhead.
detail.store_review_rule: Entities declared with itemscope must define an approved Schema.org vocabulary in itemtype; unclassified custom schemas will be ignored by super-app search engines.

title: HTML itemprop Attribute: Property Value Extraction & Type Coercion Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the itemprop global attribute, mapping an element's textual or structural value to a named property within its containing itemscope entity.

detail.specification: HTML Living Standard - Section 5.2 Microdata Attributes: itemprop
detail.technical_mechanics: Extracts values based on element semantics: text content for standard elements, href for , src for , content for , value for , and datetime for .
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Provides automated, deterministic extraction of dynamic price quotes, ISO timestamps, and currency identifiers for live super-app search cards without custom scraping scripts.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Zero runtime impact; evaluated purely by HTML DOM parsers.
detail.store_review_rule: Price and date fields in mini-app catalog cards must utilize <data value='...'> and <time datetime='...'> with valid itemprop attributes for accurate automated indexing.

title: HTML itemref Attribute: Non-Hierarchical Property Association Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the itemref global attribute, allowing an itemscope entity to incorporate properties located outside its DOM subtree using space-separated element IDs.

detail.specification: HTML Living Standard - Section 5.2 Microdata Attributes: itemref
detail.technical_mechanics: Takes a space-separated list of element ID tokens, pulling in external DOM nodes as valid properties of the referencing itemscope element.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows mini apps to maintain flexible responsive layouts (e.g. placing merchant header info in a top bar while product listings sit in a separate scrollable grid) while preserving a coherent unified semantic entity.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Resolved during DOM tree walker serialization in O(N) lookup time.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps referencing external DOM nodes via itemref must ensure referenced IDs exist within the same document and do not create circular dependency loops.

title: W3C CSS Display Module Level 3: Outer and Inner Box Formatting Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the CSS Display Module Level 3 specification, deconstructing display into discrete outer (block/inline) and inner (flow/flow-root/flex/grid) formatting models to eliminate unintended layout leakage in container environments.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Display Module Level 3 Recommendation / Candidate Recommendation
detail.technical_mechanics: Separates box generation into two-value syntax: <display-outside> (how the box participates in flow layout) and <display-inside> (how children format within the box), alongside flow-root BFC creation and contents box deconstruction.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Provides container developers with explicit, deterministic control over whether embedded mini-app widgets participate as block or inline items in the super-app host layout while sandboxing internal flex or grid flows.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Handled natively in browser and webview layout engines with zero runtime memory allocations.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini-app components embedded into host shells must specify explicit outer display values (e.g. block or inline-block) and avoid relying on obsolete legacy single-keyword display behaviors.

title: CSS display: contents Box Deconstruction Sandboxing
description: Standardizes display: contents, causing an element to generate no boxes itself while rendering its children as if they were direct children of the element's parent container.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Display Module Level 3 - Section 2.5: Box-suppressing display values
detail.technical_mechanics: Suppresses the generation of border, padding, and background for the targeted container node while projecting its child DOM nodes directly into the parent grid or flex formatting context.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows mini apps to maintain semantic wrapper components (e.g., React/Vue provider wrappers, form field containers) without polluting grid column placements or introducing extra wrapper nodes in host layout passes.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Avoids intermediate layout box tree allocations, reducing layout memory footprint in complex card lists.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini-app developers must not apply display: contents to interactive or focusable components without verifying accessibility tree exposure, ensuring assistive technologies retain correct semantics.

title: CSS display-inside: flow-root Block Formatting Context Containment
description: Standardizes display: flow-root, establishing a new independent Block Formatting Context (BFC) that contains internal floats and prevents margin collapsing across element boundaries.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Display Module Level 3 - Section 2.3: Inner display-inside values
detail.technical_mechanics: Creates an isolated BFC without requiring legacy clearfix hacks or overflow: hidden clipping side-effects, guaranteeing that internal margin calculations do not leak into outer sibling elements.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Protects super-app host list views and feed layouts from margin collapsing and float bleeding when untrusted or dynamic third-party mini-app promotional banners render in feed streams.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Resolved strictly within local layout bounds; minimizes re-layout cascades.
detail.store_review_rule: Third-party mini-app root containers and card components must declare display: flow-root or display: block flow-root to establish an independent BFC and avoid host layout corruption.

title: CSS display-outside: Inline and Block Boundary Mediation
description: Standardizes the display-outside property keywords, defining whether an element's generated principal box participates in inline-level or block-level formatting.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Display Module Level 3 - Section 2.2: Outer display-outside values
detail.technical_mechanics: Defines box exterior layout roles (block, inline, run-in), controlling line breaking, width stretching, and margin clearing behavior in the containing block.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables seamless composition of third-party inline badges, payment method chips, and rating tags within native super-app rich text descriptions and list item titles.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Integrated directly into inline layout pipeline with no asynchronous overhead.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini-app badge and chip components rendered inside super-app inline text contexts must explicitly declare display-outside: inline to prevent accidental block layout breaking.

title: W3C CSS Generated Content Module Level 3: Declarative Content Generation Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the CSS Generated Content Module Level 3 specification, providing declarative generation of pseudo-element content, counters, and localized quote marks while preventing script injection vectors.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Generated Content Module Level 3 Candidate Recommendation
detail.technical_mechanics: Defines the generation of content via ::before, ::after, and ::marker pseudo-elements using strings, image URLs, attr() functional notation, counters, and quote markers.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables lightweight, script-free injection of decorative icons, currency symbols, and localized disclaimers across mini-app components without modifying or polluting the DOM tree.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Generated content lives purely in the render tree; avoids creating full DOM node overhead in memory-constrained mobile webviews.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps must utilize CSS generated content for non-interactive decorative indicators rather than injecting unmanaged DOM nodes, optimizing rendering tree memory.

title: CSS content Property: Alternative Text & Decorative Content Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the CSS content property syntax including the alternative text slash-notation for screen reader accessibility, ensuring generated visual markers remain accessible.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Generated Content Module Level 3 - Section 2: The content property
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts string tokens, attr() values, counters, image URLs, and the modern slash syntax ('content: url(...) / "Accessible description"') to supply screen-reader labels for generated imagery.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows mini apps to display dynamic visual status icons (e.g., verified seller badge, express delivery icon) while providing native accessibility labels for visually impaired users without extra markup.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Parsed and rasterized alongside styling; zero garbage collection impact.
detail.store_review_rule: When CSS content is used to render informative icons or badges, developers must provide accessible alternative text using the slash notation or ensure redundant semantic text exists in the DOM.

title: CSS quotes Property: Multilingual Quotation Mark Localization Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the CSS quotes property, enabling automatic selection and nested rendering of typographically correct opening and closing quotation marks based on document locale.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Generated Content Module Level 3 - Section 4: Quotation Marks
detail.technical_mechanics: Specifies pairs of quotation mark characters (e.g. '«' '»' for French/Russian, '“' '”' for English, '「' '」' for CJK) applied automatically to <q> tags or open-quote/close-quote values.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Guarantees that user reviews, merchant testimonials, and terms of service excerpts in multi-country super-app deployments automatically adhere to target country typographic standards without localized template forks.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Handled during text shaping pass; minimal CPU and zero heap allocation.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps displaying user-generated reviews or customer testimonials across multilingual locales should declare css quotes or rely on lang attribute inheritance to preserve correct typographical punctuation.

title: W3C CSS Lists and Counters Module Level 3: List Item & Marker Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the CSS Lists and Counters Module Level 3 specification, defining list-item box formatting, marker box positioning, and counter incrementation rules.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Lists and Counters Module Level 3 Candidate Recommendation
detail.technical_mechanics: Formalizes the relationship between list items and their generated ::marker boxes, counter-reset, counter-increment, and list-style shorthand properties.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Provides structured ordering and hierarchical numbering for checkout breakdown steps, terms of use clauses, and multi-tier menu hierarchies in super-app mini apps.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Render-tree list item markers allocate no independent DOM instances, keeping DOM tree size lean.
detail.store_review_rule: Hierarchical step flows and terms clauses must employ standard CSS list item markers or custom counters instead of hard-coded string numbering to maintain layout responsiveness.

title: CSS ::marker Pseudo-Element: Bullet & Numbering Customization Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the ::marker pseudo-element, permitting safe, scoped styling of list bullet points and numbers (color, font, content) without disrupting list item layout flow.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Lists and Counters Module Level 3 - Section 3: Markers: The ::marker Pseudo-Element
detail.technical_mechanics: Exposes a restricted set of stylable properties (color, font-*, content, text-combine-upright, unicode-bidi) that target the marker box without triggering expensive layout reflows of the principal box.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows mini-app developers to brand list bullets with super-app primary accent colors and custom glyphs while preventing malicious style overrides from breaking parent box dimensions.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Strictly limits CSS property cascade to properties that do not trigger container geometry recalculations.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps styling custom list indicators must target the ::marker pseudo-element rather than inserting empty <span> elements, keeping the accessibility tree intact.

title: CSS list-style-type Property: Typographic Marker Symbol Governance
description: Standardizes the list-style-type property, defining built-in keyword values, string glyphs, and @counter-style references for list item markers.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Lists and Counters Module Level 3 - Section 3.1: Markers: list-style-type
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts keywords (disc, circle, square, decimal, cjk-decimal, lower-alpha), arbitrary string literals, or custom counter style names to render bullet markers.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables localized numbering systems (e.g. Lao, Thai, Khmer, Arabic) across payment step checklists and catalog category menus in regional super-app mini apps.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Executed during glyph layout rasterization without memory reallocation.
detail.store_review_rule: Payment and checkout item lists must maintain clear, unambiguous list-style-type indicators matching the user's active locale setting.

title: URL.canParse() Static Method: Fast Synchronous URL Validation Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the static URL.canParse() method, enabling zero-exception, high-performance boolean verification of URL string validity before invoking network or navigation requests.

detail.specification: WHATWG URL Living Standard - Section 4.2 URL class: canParse()
detail.technical_mechanics: Synchronously evaluates whether a given input string (and optional base) forms a valid parseable URL without throwing DOMException errors, returning a clean boolean true/false.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Provides super-app container bridge layers and deep-link routers with an ultra-fast, exception-free guardrail to pre-screen third-party navigation requests before handing them to webviews or OS intents.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Avoids expensive try/catch exception stack trace generation in high-throughput link-handling loops.
detail.store_review_rule: Container SDK bridge handlers validating dynamic navigation targets or webview link taps must utilize URL.canParse() to reject malformed inputs before dispatch.

title: URL.parse() Static Method: Safe Non-Throwing URL Construction Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the static URL.parse() method, returning a valid URL instance or null if parsing fails, replacing cumbersome try/catch constructor blocks in security-critical parsers.

detail.specification: WHATWG URL Living Standard - Section 4.2 URL class: parse()
detail.technical_mechanics: Parses an input string against an optional base URL; if parsing succeeds it returns a new URL object, otherwise it gracefully returns null rather than throwing a TypeError.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows container middleware and mini-app telemetry pipelines to safely parse query parameters, tracking tokens, and deep-link schemas without crashing background logging tasks on malformed inputs.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Returns null on failure, enabling immediate branch execution without heap thrashing from exception objects.
detail.store_review_rule: Telemetry and analytics tracking processors in mini-app SDKs must adopt URL.parse() for resilient token extraction across third-party payload handlers.

title: W3C Media Fragments URI 1.0: Deep-Linked Audio and Video Slicing Governance
description: Standardizes the W3C Media Fragments URI 1.0 specification, enabling temporal, spatial, and track-based sub-resource addressing within media files via standardized URI hash fragment syntax.

detail.specification: W3C Media Fragments URI 1.0 Recommendation
detail.technical_mechanics: Defines URI fragment parameters (e.g. #t=10,20 for temporal ranges, #xywh=160,120,320,240 for spatial clipping, #track=video for track isolation) parsed directly by user agents without server-side transcoding.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables mini apps to play exact product video previews, promotional audio highlights, and tutorial clips with zero server-side slicing overhead and optimized bandwidth consumption.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Leverages HTTP byte-range requests (RFC 9110) to stream only the requested byte segment, saving mobile data and webview memory.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini-app rich media catalogs must utilize Media Fragments URI syntax for preview snippets to avoid loading entire media containers in feed views.

title: WHATWG DOM StaticRange Interface: Lightweight Immutable Selection Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the DOM StaticRange interface, providing an immutable representation of a document range that does not observe DOM tree mutations, dramatically reducing layout thrashing.

detail.specification: WHATWG DOM Living Standard - Section 4.3 Interface StaticRange
detail.technical_mechanics: Constructed via new StaticRange({startContainer, startOffset, endContainer, endOffset}); maintains fixed boundary points that remain unaffected by subsequent node insertions, deletions, or text changes.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows mini-app rich text editors, document viewers, and coupon code highlighting overlays to record text selections with zero performance overhead, eliminating the active mutation listener cost of legacy live Range objects.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Avoids registering internal DOM tree mutation hooks; garbage collected as a simple value object without retaining tree observation chains.
detail.store_review_rule: High-frequency text inspection, search highlighting, and copy-paste interception features in mini apps must utilize StaticRange rather than live Range objects to prevent DOM mutation lock contention.

title: WHATWG DOM AbstractRange Interface: Base Range Abstraction & Boundary Governance
description: Standardizes the AbstractRange base interface, defining common boundary properties (startContainer, startOffset, endContainer, endOffset, collapsed) shared by live Range and StaticRange.

detail.specification: WHATWG DOM Living Standard - Section 4.2 Interface AbstractRange
detail.technical_mechanics: Abstract read-only base class exposing start/end container nodes and integer character/child offsets, alongside the boolean collapsed state check.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Provides a unified polymorphic interface for container security scanners and accessibility parsers to evaluate text selection ranges without coupling to specific live or static range implementations.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Read-only interface with no underlying memory management or background processing requirements.
detail.store_review_rule: Container bridge utilities accepting text selection coordinates from mini-app contexts must type-check against AbstractRange to safely support both live Range and StaticRange payloads.

title: W3C Cooperative Scheduling of Background Tasks: requestIdleCallback Architecture
description: Standardizes the W3C Cooperative Scheduling of Background Tasks specification, enabling web applications and mini apps to queue low-priority background work during browser idle periods without delaying critical user input or frame rendering.

detail.specification: W3C Cooperative Scheduling of Background Tasks Recommendation
detail.technical_mechanics: Defines an event loop integration where user agents execute queued idle callbacks when the main thread has completed rendering passes and has unused frame time remaining before the next vsync tick.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Prevents mini apps from monopolizing the single UI thread in mobile webviews; non-essential tasks like telemetry beacons, analytics flushes, and background pre-fetching run strictly inside idle slices.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: User agents clamp idle callback periods to a maximum of 50ms to preserve responsiveness to unexpected user touch gestures.
detail.store_review_rule: Non-essential background operations (telemetry, offline cache sync, data indexing) must be dispatched via requestIdleCallback rather than blocking initial page execution scripts.

title: Window.requestIdleCallback() & cancelIdleCallback(): Cooperative Task Execution API
description: Standardizes Window.requestIdleCallback() and Window.cancelIdleCallback() methods, permitting registration of low-priority background functions with optional timeout fallback execution.

detail.specification: W3C Cooperative Scheduling of Background Tasks - Section 4: WindowOrWorkerGlobalScope.requestIdleCallback
detail.technical_mechanics: Accepts a callback receiving an IdleDeadline object and an optional options dictionary containing a 'timeout' property in milliseconds. If the timeout expires before an idle period occurs, the task is forced into the regular task queue.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows container SDK bridge layers and mini apps to gracefully schedule heavy analytics logging without stalling 60fps/120fps UI scrolling animations.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Callbacks cancelled via cancelIdleCallback(handle) immediately release internal closure references, avoiding memory leak retention.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini-app telemetry SDKs must provide timeout options on requestIdleCallback to guarantee eventual delivery while yielding priority to high-frequency frame rendering.

title: IdleDeadline Interface: Frame Budget Allocation & DidTimeout Verification
description: Standardizes the IdleDeadline interface passed to idle callbacks, exposing timeRemaining() high-resolution microsecond queries and didTimeout boolean status for granular time-slicing.

detail.specification: W3C Cooperative Scheduling of Background Tasks - Section 5: The IdleDeadline interface
detail.technical_mechanics: Provides timeRemaining() returning a DOMHighResTimeStamp representing estimated milliseconds remaining in the current idle period, alongside didTimeout indicating whether execution occurred due to timeout expiration.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Empowers mini-app developers to chunk complex client-side calculations (e.g., catalog search filtering, vector rendering) into re-entrant work loops that pause when timeRemaining() drops below 5ms.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Time allocation is bounded by browser compositor cycles; loops that fail to yield within their allocated budget trigger main thread jank flags in host telemetry.
detail.store_review_rule: Iterative processing inside idle callbacks must inspect deadline.timeRemaining() > 0 before each step and reschedule unfinished units if time has elapsed.

title: queueMicrotask() Global Method: Immediate Asynchronous Sequencing Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the queueMicrotask() global API across Window and Worker contexts, allowing deterministic scheduling of microtasks that execute before yielding back to the event loop macrotask queue.

detail.specification: WHATWG HTML Living Standard - Section 8.1.4.3: Microtask queuing
detail.technical_mechanics: Enqueues a callback function to the microtask queue, which is drained immediately after the current JavaScript execution stack empties and before the browser processes UI rendering, layout, or next macrotasks.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Provides a clean, standardized primitive for mini-app reactive state libraries and JSBridge response batching without relying on Promise.resolve().then() boilerplate or setTimeout(0) macrotask latency.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Replaces synthetic Promise chains, reducing V8/JavaScriptCore microtask wrapper object allocations by up to 40%.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini-app frameworks coordinating atomic state batching or bridge acknowledgement callbacks must utilize queueMicrotask() rather than hacky setTimeout(0) macrotasks.

title: WHATWG HTML Timers and User Prompts: Microtask Checkpoint & Event Loop Governance
description: Standardizes the WHATWG HTML event loop microtask checkpoint algorithm, governing execution order, unhandled rejection reporting, and starvation mitigation across webview containers.

detail.specification: WHATWG HTML Living Standard - Section 8.6: Timers and user prompts & Section 8.1.6: Processing model
detail.technical_mechanics: Specifies that microtask checkpoints run after script evaluations and callback invocations; recursive microtask scheduling causes continuous execution, completely starving macrotask handling and user input.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Establishes container runtime safety rules: container SDKs monitor main-thread execution time and enforce watchdog timeouts to terminate frozen webviews executing unbounded recursive microtask loops.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Container host watchdog detects prolonged microtask drainage exceeding 500ms and triggers unhandled rejection or script termination.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps must not enqueue recursive microtasks indefinitely; static analysis scans will reject packages with recursive queueMicrotask patterns lacking exit conditions.

title: W3C CSS Box Sizing Module Level 4: Intrinsic & Extrinsic Dimension Governance
description: Standardizes the W3C CSS Box Sizing Module Level 4 specification, defining advanced intrinsic sizing keywords, aspect-ratio integration, and container-relative dimensional resolutions.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Box Sizing Module Level 4 Working Draft
detail.technical_mechanics: Formalizes algorithms for intrinsic sizing (min-content, max-content, fit-content), preferred aspect ratio resolution, and stretch-fit constraints during multi-pass layout formatting.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Provides formal sizing guarantees for mini-app modular card widgets and responsive component bundles rendered within variable-width super-app host viewports.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Intrinsic sizing algorithms eliminate multi-phase layout thrashing by providing deterministic single-pass dimensional calculation rules.
detail.store_review_rule: Dynamic widget components designed for embedded super-app home feeds must conform to CSS Sizing Level 4 intrinsic containment to prevent host feed re-layouts.

title: CSS aspect-ratio Property: Declarative Preferred Ratio & CLS Elimination
description: Standardizes the CSS aspect-ratio property, allowing elements to maintain consistent proportional width-to-height dimensions before child content or media assets load.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Box Sizing Module Level 4 - Section 3: Aspect Ratios: the aspect-ratio property
detail.technical_mechanics: Sets a preferred aspect ratio (e.g., '16 / 9', '1 / 1', '4 / 3') that guides automatic dimension calculation when either width or height is unspecified.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Eliminates Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) in mini-app e-commerce product grids, banner carousels, and video thumbnails by reserving exact pixel spaces before remote imagery arrives.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Computed instantly during box generation without waiting for asynchronous image decoding, preserving layout stability.
detail.store_review_rule: All image placeholders, product card media containers, and banner banners in mini apps must declare explicit aspect-ratio properties to ensure zero layout shift.

title: CSS contain-intrinsic-size Shorthand: Placeholder Geometry for Offscreen Elements
description: Standardizes the CSS contain-intrinsic-size shorthand property, allowing developers to define explicit placeholder dimensions for elements rendered under content-visibility: auto.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Box Sizing Module Level 4 - Section 4: Intrinsic Size: the contain-intrinsic-size properties
detail.technical_mechanics: Specifies inline and block fallback dimensions (e.g., 'contain-intrinsic-size: 1000px 500px' or 'auto 300px') applied when an element is subject to size containment and its contents are skipped.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables massive scroll performance gains in mini apps containing thousands of catalog items (e.g. food menus, item lists) without causing scrollbar jumping when offscreen DOM is pruned.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Maintains accurate scroll heights while allowing the browser engine to unrender 90%+ of off-screen DOM trees, slashing mobile RAM usage.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps utilizing content-visibility: auto for long lists must declare contain-intrinsic-size with realistic item estimates to prevent scrollbar jumping during fast fling scrolling.

title: CSS contain-intrinsic-inline-size & contain-intrinsic-block-size: Flow-Relative Placeholders
description: Standardizes flow-relative intrinsic size placeholder properties, enabling bidirectional and vertical text layout support for offscreen rendered elements.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Box Sizing Module Level 4 - Section 4.1: The contain-intrinsic-width, contain-intrinsic-height, and contain-intrinsic-inline-size properties
detail.technical_mechanics: Applies intrinsic size containment specifically along the inline axis or block axis, dynamically adapting to writing-mode changes (horizontal-tb vs vertical-rl).
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Essential for multilingual super apps deploying across both horizontal Latin/CJK feeds and vertical East Asian or BiDi RTL layouts, ensuring placeholder stability regardless of writing orientation.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Decouples inline axis size containment from block axis flow calculations, optimizing rendering memory caches.
detail.store_review_rule: International mini apps with multi-orientation or multi-script support must use logical contain-intrinsic-inline-size/block-size properties rather than hardcoded physical dimensions.

title: CSS contain-intrinsic-block-size Property: Block-Axis Placeholder Governance
description: Standardizes the CSS contain-intrinsic-block-size property, defining explicit fallback height or vertical dimension reservations for offscreen elements subject to size containment.

detail.specification: W3C CSS Box Sizing Module Level 4 - Section 4.1: Sizing Off-screen Content
detail.technical_mechanics: Specifies the intrinsic block size (height in horizontal writing modes, width in vertical writing modes) using length units or the auto keyword with a fallback length.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Provides exact vertical space reservation for virtualized list items in mobile mini apps, eliminating scroll jitter and sudden jump cuts during rapid upward flings.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Allows DOM tree virtualization to safely unmount heavy card content while maintaining precise scrollbar thumb positioning.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini-app infinite scroll lists employing content-visibility must declare contain-intrinsic-block-size matching estimated row heights to ensure smooth kinetic scrolling.

title: W3C Remote Playback API: Wireless Media Casting Architecture
description: Standardizes the W3C Remote Playback API specification, providing web applications and mini apps with standardized controls to project media streams to external playback devices like smart TVs and speakers.

detail.specification: W3C Remote Playback API Recommendation
detail.technical_mechanics: Defines an asynchronous pipeline connecting HTMLMediaElement instances to remote rendering devices (AirPlay, Google Cast, DLNA), managing discovery, connection handshakes, and remote playback synchronization.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables super-app video streaming mini apps, live shopping streams, and fitness workout apps to cast content to living room screens while keeping playback controls inside the mobile super app.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Decouples media decoding from the mobile device when remote rendering takes over, reducing phone heat generation and extending mobile battery life.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps initiating remote media casting must handle disconnected states gracefully, seamlessly resuming local playback without audio stutter.

title: RemotePlayback Interface: State Machine & Event Dispatching Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the RemotePlayback interface, exposing state queries ('disconnected', 'connecting', 'connected') and lifecycle events ('connecting', 'connect', 'disconnect').

detail.specification: W3C Remote Playback API - Section 5: RemotePlayback interface
detail.technical_mechanics: Tracks the remote playback state machine, firing events as external connections are negotiated or dropped, and synchronizing media commands across transport protocols.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows container UI chrome to render unified 'Cast' icon indicators and provide synchronized playback sliders matching the active state of remote hardware.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Automatically cleans up underlying network socket descriptors when state transitions to 'disconnected'.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps supporting remote casting must observe RemotePlayback 'disconnect' events to update UI affordances and prevent orphaned casting sessions.

title: HTMLMediaElement.remote & disableremoteplayback: Privacy Sandboxing & DRM Controls
description: Standardizes the HTMLMediaElement.remote property and the declarative disableremoteplayback attribute, enabling programmatic casting access alongside DRM and privacy enforcement.

detail.specification: W3C Remote Playback API - Section 6: Extensions to HTMLMediaElement
detail.technical_mechanics: Exposes the RemotePlayback instance via mediaElement.remote, and respects the boolean 'disableremoteplayback' attribute which completely deactivates remote casting discovery and playback for that element.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Provides critical security and privacy sandboxing: sensitive KYC verification video streams, banking instructional videos, or proprietary DRM-protected media can declare disableremoteplayback to prevent accidental or malicious wireless eavesdropping.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: When disableremoteplayback is active, the browser completely bypasses device discovery threads, reducing radio power consumption.
detail.store_review_rule: Media elements handling confidential user data or DRM-protected streams in mini apps must set the disableremoteplayback attribute to prohibit unauthorized wireless transmission.

title: RemotePlayback.watchAvailability(): Device Discovery & Power Governance
description: Standardizes RemotePlayback.watchAvailability() and cancelWatchAvailability(), allowing mini apps to monitor the presence of remote receivers with container-level power throttling.

detail.specification: W3C Remote Playback API - Section 5.1: Availability monitoring
detail.technical_mechanics: Registers an availability callback invoked when compatible casting hardware is detected on the local network, returning a promise resolving to an integer callback ID.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Container SDKs can govern discovery polling rates to avoid Wi-Fi radio battery drain on mobile devices, throttling discovery when the mini app is backgrounded or hidden.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Requires calling cancelWatchAvailability(id) when components unmount; containers enforce auto-cancellation when webview visibility state changes to hidden.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini-app video players must invoke cancelWatchAvailability() upon page destruction or navigation away to prevent lingering background mDNS/SSDP discovery probes.

title: RemotePlayback.prompt(): User Activation & Native Picker Sheet Orchestration
description: Standardizes RemotePlayback.prompt(), allowing mini apps to trigger the user agent's native device selection picker sheet subject to strict user activation requirements.

detail.specification: W3C Remote Playback API - Section 5.2: Initiating playback
detail.technical_mechanics: Triggers the system casting dialog; throws an InvalidStateError if disableremoteplayback is present, and throws a NotAllowedError if not called from a transient user interaction (tap/click event).
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Prevents mini-app clickjacking and rogue casting spam; ensures that the native OS device sheet only opens when a user intentionally taps an explicit 'Cast to TV' button.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Rejects instantly if called without user gesture, preventing unwanted modal overlays or UI freezes.
detail.store_review_rule: Calls to RemotePlayback.prompt() must be directly triggered by user click/tap handlers; automated or scripted invocations will fail store security review.

title: Element.requestFullscreen(): Top-Layer Screen Immersion & Activation Governance
description: Standardizes Element.requestFullscreen(), placing a DOM element into full-screen mode on the top-layer subject to transient user activation and Permissions Policy controls.

detail.specification: Fullscreen API Living Standard - Section 4: API
detail.technical_mechanics: Places the element into the top layer and sizes it to fill the screen; requires transient user activation (gesture) and checks the 'fullscreen' feature policy. Returns a promise resolving when full-screen transition completes.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Super apps hosting media players, interactive documents, and canvas games must govern fullscreen transitions to prevent mini apps from spoofing host OS UI, system status bars, or native payment modals.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Automatically exits fullscreen if the webview loses focus, is occluded by native host dialogs, or navigates away.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps must only invoke requestFullscreen() inside direct user interaction handlers; automated full-screen traps or attempts to disguise system status bars will fail review.

title: Document.exitFullscreen(): Deterministic Fullscreen Teardown & Back-Button Arbitration
description: Standardizes Document.exitFullscreen(), providing a programmatic teardown mechanism for fullscreen presentation and coordinating with native back-button dismissals.

detail.specification: Fullscreen API Living Standard - Section 4: API (exitFullscreen)
detail.technical_mechanics: Takes the document out of fullscreen mode, popping elements from the top layer and firing a fullscreenchange event on the affected document and elements.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables seamless harmonization with native Android back navigation and iOS swipe-to-dismiss gestures, ensuring users are never trapped in a full-screen mini-app container.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Container intercepts OS back gestures to call exitFullscreen() before popping the mini-app route from the native navigation stack.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps utilizing fullscreen mode must provide an easily accessible on-screen exit button or handle system back events to call Document.exitFullscreen().

title: Document.fullscreenElement: Top-Layer Inspection & Embedded Iframe Sandboxing
description: Standardizes Document.fullscreenElement, exposing the element currently positioned in fullscreen mode on the top-layer stack or null if fullscreen is inactive.

detail.specification: Fullscreen API Living Standard - Section 4: API (fullscreenElement)
detail.technical_mechanics: Returns the topmost element in the document's top layer that is presented fullscreen, or null. In cross-origin iframes, access respects boundary scoping.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows the host container SDK and mini-app shell to inspect whether active UI overlays or video components are in fullscreen, adjusting overlay z-indexes and floating action buttons accordingly.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Synchronously resets to null upon exitFullscreen or container window destruction.
detail.store_review_rule: Host SDK bridges and mini apps must query fullscreenElement to verify UI state prior to initiating native modal sheets or popup alerts.

title: ScreenOrientation.lock(): Display Orientation Locking & Sensor Arbitration
description: Standardizes ScreenOrientation.lock(), permitting mini apps to request display orientation locks (portrait, landscape, or specific sub-types) subject to fullscreen and policy prerequisites.

detail.specification: Screen Orientation API - Section 5.2: Locking the screen orientation
detail.technical_mechanics: Asynchronously locks the screen orientation to an OrientationLockType (e.g., 'landscape', 'portrait-primary'); in mobile browsers, typically requires the document to be in fullscreen mode.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Crucial for immersive mini apps such as games, spreadsheets, or panoramic video streaming where fixed landscape view is required, preventing accidental auto-rotation disorientation.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Automatically releases the orientation lock when the mini app is backgrounded, the screen turns off, or fullscreen is exited.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps must release orientation locks via unlock() upon exiting the relevant view, and must gracefully handle orientation lock rejection on unsupported platforms.

title: ScreenOrientation.angle: Real-Time Rotation Telemetry & Layout Adaptation
description: Standardizes ScreenOrientation.angle, providing the document's current clockwise rotation angle relative to the device natural orientation.

detail.specification: Screen Orientation API - Section 5.1: The ScreenOrientation interface
detail.technical_mechanics: Exposes the current screen rotation angle as an unsigned short (0, 90, 180, 270 degrees), firing the 'change' event on screen.orientation when rotation occurs.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables responsive mini-app UI components, canvas rendering engines, and camera/scanner overlays to compute transform matrices that align perfectly with the physical device frame.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Telemetry updates are passive and synchronized with hardware display server v-sync, generating zero idle battery drain.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps with custom camera previews, barcode scanners, or canvas graphics must read ScreenOrientation.angle to prevent upside-down or misaligned viewfinder projections.

title: Element.requestPointerLock(): Mouse Cursor Lock & Raw Motion Access Governance
description: Standardizes Element.requestPointerLock(), locking the mouse cursor to a specific element and providing raw delta movement coordinates for 3D/immersive mini apps.

detail.specification: Pointer Lock 2.0 - Section 5: Extensions to Element
detail.technical_mechanics: Hides the mouse cursor and captures all mouse movement directly into delta movements (movementX/movementY), unrestricted by screen boundaries. Requires transient user activation and passes options like unadjustedMovement.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Essential for 3D WebGL/WebGPU games, CAD/GIS viewers, and precision desktop mini apps within super apps, while requiring strict container controls to prevent hostile cursor hijacking.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Pointer lock is automatically broken and released if the user presses Escape, navigates away, or switches focus away from the super app webview.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps must only request pointer lock in response to explicit user interaction, and must visually instruct users how to exit (e.g. Esc key).

title: Document.exitPointerLock(): Programmatic Cursor Release & Modal Protection
description: Standardizes Document.exitPointerLock(), releasing an active pointer lock asynchronously and restoring standard system cursor telemetry.

detail.specification: Pointer Lock 2.0 - Section 4: Extensions to Document (exitPointerLock)
detail.technical_mechanics: Releases the pointer lock on whatever element currently holds it, returning mouse movements to absolute coordinates and restoring the system cursor.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables the host container to reclaim mouse control whenever native host menus, payment sheets, or KYC verification modals are displayed over an active game/canvas mini app.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Synchronously queued to fire pointerlockchange upon successful teardown.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps using pointer lock must invoke Document.exitPointerLock() immediately when pausing, opening internal menus, or yielding focus.

title: Document.pointerLockElement: Active Pointer Lock Inspection & Sandboxing
description: Standardizes Document.pointerLockElement, returning the element currently locking the mouse pointer or null if no element holds pointer lock.

detail.specification: Pointer Lock 2.0 - Section 4: Extensions to Document (pointerLockElement)
detail.technical_mechanics: Provides an element reference to the active pointer lock holder; if called across shadow boundaries or cross-origin contexts, standard boundary retargeting rules apply.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows super-app container harnesses and mini-app component managers to assert whether an internal canvas has captured cursor inputs before dispatching overlay gestures.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Reflects null immediately upon lock loss without requiring manual polling.
detail.store_review_rule: Container telemetry and event router scripts must inspect pointerLockElement to avoid dispatching pointer-dependent gesture events to locked canvas nodes.

title: Document pointerlockchange Event: Lifecycle Synchronization & State Transitions
description: Standardizes the document pointerlockchange event, dispatched when pointer lock is successfully engaged or disengaged.

detail.specification: Pointer Lock 2.0 - Section 7: Events (pointerlockchange)
detail.technical_mechanics: A simple event fired asynchronously at Document when the target element acquires or surrenders pointer lock. Developers compare pointerLockElement with target elements to discern entry/exit.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows the mini-app UI to toggle in-game HUDs, pause screens, and custom crosshair overlays dynamically as pointer lock states alternate.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Guaranteed to fire whenever system interruptions or user Esc key presses break pointer lock.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini-app game engines must bind to the pointerlockchange event to pause game loops and re-display menus when the user exits lock via the Esc key.

title: MouseEvent.movementX & movementY: High-Precision Relative Cursor Telemetry
description: Standardizes MouseEvent.movementX and movementY properties, delivering high-precision relative mouse delta coordinates during pointer lock.

detail.specification: Pointer Lock 2.0 - Section 6: Extensions to MouseEvent
detail.technical_mechanics: Provides the delta displacement in screen coordinates between the current event and previous mouse event, bypassing display edge clamping.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Provides the mathematical input necessary for 3D camera controls, interactive medical scan slicers, and panoramic tour mini apps within enterprise super apps.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Deltas are calculated directly from raw hardware mouse packets, avoiding layout reflows and memory overhead.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps must sanitize and clamp extreme movementX/movementY values to prevent numerical overflow in physics or camera transformation calculations.

title: PresentationRequest: Second-Screen Presentation Initiation & Target Governance
description: Standardizes the PresentationRequest constructor, enabling mini apps to initiate or reconnect to presentations on secondary displays and external monitors.

detail.specification: Presentation API - Section 5.1: PresentationRequest
detail.technical_mechanics: Constructs an object with one or more presentation target URLs (e.g. ['https://example.com/presenter']); provides getAvailability() and start() methods.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables retail POS mini apps, digital signage controllers, classroom presentation tools, and financial dashboard mini apps to project auxiliary views onto connected external displays or TVs.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Target URLs must strictly match approved domain allowlists defined in the mini-app manifest to prevent external origin content injection.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps initiating PresentationRequest must declare all presentation target URLs in their manifest security policy for container review and origin validation.

title: PresentationRequest.start(): Native Device Picker Dialog & Display Pairing
description: Standardizes PresentationRequest.start(), prompting the user agent's native display picker dialog to connect to an available secondary screen subject to user activation.

detail.specification: Presentation API - Section 5.4: Starting a presentation
detail.technical_mechanics: Triggers native UI display selection; requires transient user activation (user gesture). Returns a promise resolving to a PresentationConnection upon user confirmation.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Ensures that secondary screen casting cannot be launched silently by background scripts, protecting user privacy in public/office environments.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Rejects immediately with NotAllowedError if invoked without transient activation or if the user cancels display selection.
detail.store_review_rule: PresentationRequest.start() must only be called within direct user click/tap event handlers; unauthorized background invocations will be blocked by container sandboxes.

title: PresentationConnection: Bi-Directional Multi-Screen Messaging & Lifecycle States
description: Standardizes PresentationConnection, providing bi-directional message exchange (strings and binary buffers) and connection lifecycle monitoring between controlling and presenting browsing contexts.

detail.specification: Presentation API - Section 5.5: PresentationConnection
detail.technical_mechanics: Represents an active 2-way communication channel between controller and presentation; exposes state ('connecting', 'connected', 'closed', 'terminated'), send(data), close(), and terminate().
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Powers real-time synchronization between the primary handheld super-app interface (e.g. cashier tablet) and customer-facing external displays (e.g. customer payment terminal or order screen).
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Automatically enters 'terminated' state when the presentation window closes, triggering cleanup in the controlling mini app.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps must handle state transitions ('closed', 'terminated') cleanly to prevent memory leaks and unhandled promise rejections on disconnected displays.

title: PresentationReceiver: Auxiliary Display Incoming Connection Mediation
description: Standardizes PresentationReceiver (navigator.presentation.receiver), enabling the receiver browsing context on the auxiliary display to accept incoming connections.

detail.specification: Presentation API - Section 5.9: PresentationReceiver
detail.technical_mechanics: Exposes connectionList promise resolving to a PresentationConnectionList, allowing the presentation receiver page to accept incoming controller connections.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Provides the receiving mini-app page runtime API to establish communication with the handheld super app on TV screens, in-store kiosks, or smart displays.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Receiver contexts operate under lightweight sandbox restrictions, ensuring no sensitive local storage or credentials can be leaked to external displays.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini-app receiver pages must sanitize incoming presentation messages before rendering to avoid Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) on auxiliary display terminals.

title: PresentationAvailability: External Screen Detection & Adaptive UI Throttling
description: Standardizes PresentationAvailability, allowing controlling mini apps to monitor the availability of compatible secondary displays and adapt UI affordances accordingly.

detail.specification: Presentation API - Section 5.3: Monitoring presentation display availability
detail.technical_mechanics: Exposes a boolean 'value' indicating whether compatible external screens are reachable, and dispatches 'change' events when display availability toggles.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables mini apps to show or hide 'Present to Second Screen' buttons dynamically, avoiding user confusion when no secondary screens exist.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Display discovery probes can be throttled or suspended by the container when the mini app is hidden or low battery mode is active.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini-app UI components must conditionally display presentation controls based on PresentationAvailability.value to maintain high UX standards.

title: Gamepad API: Multi-Device Input Architecture & Permissions-Policy Sandboxing
description: Standardizes the Gamepad API Living Standard architecture, governing direct hardware input event dispatching, secure context execution, and container permissions policy delegation for external controllers.

detail.specification: Gamepad API W3C Candidate Recommendation / WHATWG Living Standard
detail.technical_mechanics: Enables web and mini-app runtimes to interface directly with connected USB/Bluetooth gamepads; gated behind Permissions-Policy: gamepad and restricted to secure contexts (HTTPS); requires transient user interaction to prevent background fingerprinting.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows gaming, arcade, and accessibility mini apps inside the super app to connect seamlessly to physical gamepads without requiring custom native SDK bridges.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Input access is suspended and input arrays cleared when the hosting mini app loses focus or enters background lifecycle state.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps declaring gamepad support must declare Permissions-Policy: gamepad in their mini app manifest and provide on-screen touch fallbacks for touch-only devices.

title: Gamepad Interface: Standard Mapping, Normalized Axes & Button State Topology
description: Standardizes the Gamepad interface, establishing canonical button/axis mappings (the Standard Gamepad layout) and normalized float coordinate topologies (-1.0 to +1.0) across heterogeneous input hardware.

detail.specification: Gamepad API - Section 5.1: Gamepad interface & Standard Gamepad layout
detail.technical_mechanics: Exposes axes (array of double numbers between -1.0 and 1.0 representing thumbsticks), buttons (array of GamepadButton objects), mapping (standard layout mapping string), connected, index, and timestamp.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Guarantees that mini games running inside the super app render identical control responses regardless of whether the physical hardware is an Xbox, DualShock, or generic HID controller.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Gamepad index mapping is recycled upon disconnection, preventing dangling references or memory leaks in long-running mini apps.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini games must implement deadzone filtering (minimum 0.05-0.1 threshold) on axes values to avoid stick drift and unintended player movement.

title: GamepadHapticActuator: Dual-Rumble Vibration & Tactile Feedback Sandboxing
description: Standardizes GamepadHapticActuator, enabling programmatic force-feedback and dual-rumble vibration effects with bounded magnitude and duration parameters.

detail.specification: Gamepad API - Section 5.6: GamepadHapticActuator interface & playEffect method
detail.technical_mechanics: Provides playEffect(type, params) supporting dual-rumble with duration, startDelay, strongMagnitude (low-frequency motor, 0.0-1.0), and weakMagnitude (high-frequency motor, 0.0-1.0); returns a Promise resolving to GamepadHapticsResult.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Delivers tactile feedback for gaming mini apps and high-impact physical interactions without draining host device battery via uncontrolled infinite loops.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Container automatically cancels active vibration effects and throttles haptic call frequency when device battery is low (<15%) or when the mini app is backgrounded.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps must not trigger vibration durations exceeding 5000ms in a single call, and must provide an in-game toggle to disable haptics for accessibility.

title: GamepadButton: Digital Press & Analog Pressure Value Normalization
description: Standardizes GamepadButton, providing unified normalization across digital on/off switches and analog pressure-sensitive triggers.

detail.specification: Gamepad API - Section 5.5: GamepadButton interface
detail.technical_mechanics: Exposes pressed (boolean threshold), touched (capacitive sensing boolean), and value (floating-point number between 0.0 and 1.0 representing analog trigger depression).
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables mini apps to implement granular analog acceleration, braking, and pressure-sensitive interactions with strict hardware isolation.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Button states are immediately zeroed out if controller communication is interrupted or if the mini app tab loses focus.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini app input parsers must query value rather than pressed when processing analog shoulder triggers (L2/R2) to support variable inputs.

title: Navigator.getGamepads: Polling Loop Lifecycle & Connection Event Orchestration
description: Standardizes Navigator.getGamepads() snapshot polling and gamepadconnected / gamepaddisconnected window event orchestration within the container lifecycle.

detail.specification: Gamepad API - Section 5.2: Navigator.getGamepads() method & connection events
detail.technical_mechanics: Returns an array of Gamepad or null objects representing a point-in-time hardware snapshot; requires polling within requestAnimationFrame; complemented by gamepadconnected and gamepaddisconnected Window events.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows the container to throttle gamepad polling loops when the mini app is occluded or in an inactive tab, saving battery and CPU cycles.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: The container intercepts getGamepads() when the mini app is hidden or suspended, returning an array of nulls to prevent background tracking.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps must bind input reading to requestAnimationFrame loops and must halt polling immediately when document.hidden is true.

title: Web Speech API: SpeechRecognition & SpeechSynthesis Dual Architecture
description: Standardizes the Web Speech API architecture, governing speech-to-text recognition and text-to-speech synthesis pipelines under strict container privacy and permission mediation.

detail.specification: W3C Community Group Specification - Web Speech API: Architecture & Security Overview
detail.technical_mechanics: Provides dual interfaces: SpeechRecognition for converting audio stream input to text transcripts, and SpeechSynthesis for generating speech audio from text strings; requires microphone permission and secure context execution.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables voice search, conversational AI commerce, accessibility, and voice navigation within mini apps without requiring third-party audio recording SDKs.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Audio streaming is automatically suspended and microphone hardware released if the mini app moves to background or if container memory pressure triggers audio eviction.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps must display explicit container UI indicators while speech recognition is actively recording audio, and must obtain prior user consent before opening the microphone stream.

title: SpeechRecognition: Continuous Recognition & Interim Results Streaming
description: Standardizes the SpeechRecognition interface, managing continuous capture, interim hypothesis streaming, and BCP 47 language configuration for voice input.

detail.specification: Web Speech API - Section 5.1: SpeechRecognition interface
detail.technical_mechanics: Exposes continuous (boolean), interimResults (boolean), lang (BCP 47 language tag), maxAlternatives, start(), stop(), and abort(); fires audiostart, speechstart, result, speechend, and audioend lifecycle events.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Allows mini apps to provide real-time conversational search and dictation in multiple languages while allowing the super app to enforce language locale matching.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Calling abort() immediately terminates audio capture and discards buffered audio chunks without waiting for remaining network recognition results.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps must set continuous to false by default for single-intent voice commands to minimize unnecessary server recognition bandwidth and battery draw.

title: SpeechRecognitionEvent: Recognition Result Tree & Confidence Scoring
description: Standardizes SpeechRecognitionEvent and SpeechRecognitionResultList, establishing a hierarchical result data model with confidence scoring and alternative hypotheses.

detail.specification: Web Speech API - Section 5.1.2: SpeechRecognitionEvent & SpeechRecognitionResult
detail.technical_mechanics: Delivers results as SpeechRecognitionResultList composed of SpeechRecognitionResult items containing SpeechRecognitionAlternative entries with transcript string and confidence score (float 0.0 to 1.0); isFinal indicates hypothesis finality.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Provides standardized, verifiable text transcription parsing for commerce order workflows, voice search, and voice form filling across diverse device speech engines.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Result objects are transient event parameters and garbage collected following event loop dispatch to maintain minimal memory footprint.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps must check isFinal before executing irreversible state actions (e.g. initiating payments or submitting orders) and filter alternatives with low confidence scores (<0.6).

title: SpeechSynthesis: Text-to-Speech Queue Orchestration & State Machine
description: Standardizes the SpeechSynthesis controller (window.speechSynthesis), providing FIFO utterance queuing, playback controls, and voice engine lifecycle introspection.

detail.specification: Web Speech API - Section 5.2: SpeechSynthesis interface
detail.technical_mechanics: Exposes speak(utterance), cancel(), pause(), resume(), getVoices(), and readonly state flags (pending, speaking, paused); dispatches voiceschanged when available voice profiles change.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Powers accessibility screen reading, turn-by-turn navigation alerts, and conversational bot responses across mini apps without third-party audio player bloat.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Container invokes speechSynthesis.cancel() automatically when transitioning between mini apps or when the active mini app is closed, clearing all queued utterances instantly.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps must invoke cancel() before initiating a new high-priority voice prompt to avoid voice backlog build-up, and must never play speech when the mini app is muted or backgrounded.

title: SpeechSynthesisUtterance: Speech Synthesis Parameters & Event Dispatching
description: Standardizes SpeechSynthesisUtterance, configuring text payload, voice selection, pitch, speaking rate, volume, and boundary synchronization events.

detail.specification: Web Speech API - Section 5.2.3: SpeechSynthesisUtterance interface
detail.technical_mechanics: Configures text string, voice (SpeechSynthesisVoice), volume (0.0 to 1.0), rate (0.1 to 10.0), and pitch (0.0 to 2.0); dispatches start, end, error, pause, resume, mark, and boundary events.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Enables fine-grained acoustic tuning for accessibility cues, localized multilingual announcements, and voice shopping assistance.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Long text utterances can be split into paragraph-level segments to avoid audio buffer underruns and facilitate smooth interruption and garbage collection.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps must sanitize text strings passed to SpeechSynthesisUtterance to strip unpronounced markup, control characters, or malicious prompt injection scripts.

title: PannerNode: 3D Spatial Audio Positioning & Acoustic Attenuation
description: Standardizes PannerNode, enabling full 3D spatial audio positioning, HRTF binaural processing, and configurable distance attenuation models for interactive mini apps.

detail.specification: Web Audio API W3C Recommendation - Section 5.17: PannerNode interface
detail.technical_mechanics: Positions sound sources in 3D Cartesian space; exposes positionX/Y/Z, orientationX/Y/Z, panningModel ('equalpower', 'HRTF'), distanceModel ('linear', 'inverse', 'exponential'), refDistance, maxDistance, and rolloffFactor.
detail.superapp_container_relevance: Provides realistic directional audio and immersive acoustic environments for games, AR shopping previews, and interactive virtual events running inside mini apps.
detail.eviction_and_pressure_handling: Container can downscale panningModel from HRTF to 'equalpower' dynamically when CPU utilization exceeds 80% to prevent audio frame dropping.
detail.store_review_rule: Mini apps using PannerNode must specify reasonable maxDistance bounds to ensure audio sources do not calculate spatialization curves indefinitely.
